articles.title: Image-Guided Pavement Defect Recognition in GPR Data with novel 3D Deep Learning Architecture
articles.content: Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) is a widely adopted non-destructive sensing technology for subsurface inspection in civil and transportation engineering. Despite its potential for pavement condition assessment, the large-scale application of GPR in automated inspection has two key challenges: the scarcity of annotated real-world datasets and the lack of deep learning models designed for the unique characteristics of 3-Dimensional (3D) GPR data. This study addresses these limitations by firstly introducing a cost-effective data preparation pipeline that integrates orthomosaic Red Green Blue (RGB) imagery with 3D GPR scans to generate annotated 3D GPR datasets. The proposed method uses the aligned segments of RGB and GPR data, using pavement surface images as a reference to transfer labels of surface-visible defects to corresponding GPR segments, enabling efficient large-scale annotation in a real-world dataset collected on a highway section under operation. In addition to the dataset contribution, we propose a specialised 3D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture incorporating residual connections, mixed convolutional kernel sizes, and both depthwise and channelwise attention mechanisms to enhance feature representation and defect classification. The model is evaluated on binary classification tasks for detecting patch and crack defects in pavement structures. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed network outperforms baseline architectures across multiple evaluation metrics. Ablation studies further confirm the effectiveness of the designed architectural components. This work contributes a scalable and practical method for real-world dataset generation, along with a novel deep learning framework.

articles.title_zh: 在GPR Data中用小说"3D"深层学习架构进行图像引导的 Pavement Defect识别
articles.content_zh: 地面穿透雷达(GPR)是民用和运输工程中广泛采用的用于地表下检查的无损感测技术. 尽管有可能进行人行道状况评估,但在自动化检查中大规模应用GPR有两大挑战:缺乏附加说明的现实世界数据集和缺乏为3-Dimensional(3D)GPR数据的独特性而设计的深度学习模型. 本研究解决了这些局限性,首先引入了成本效益高的数据制备管道,将正统红绿蓝(RGB)图像与3D GPR扫描相融合,生成附加注释的3D GPR数据集. 拟议方法使用RGB和GPR数据的对齐部分,将人行道表面图像用作将地表可见缺陷的标签转移到相应的GPR部分的参考,使得在运行中的高速公路部分所收集的现实世界数据集能够高效地进行大规模注解. 除了数据集贡献外,我们提议建立一个专门的3D Cinvolutional Neural Network(CNN)架构,其中包含剩余连接,混合上演内核大小,以及深度和分道扬镳的注意机制,以加强地物代表性和缺陷分类. 该模型通过二进制分类任务进行评估,以检测人行道结构中的补丁和裂缝缺陷. 实验结果表明,拟议的网络在多个评价衡量尺度上超过了基线结构。 校正研究进一步证实了所设计的建筑构件的有效性. 这项工作为现实世界的数据集生成提供了可伸缩而实用的方法,同时也提供了新的深层学习框架.

articles.title: Detecting Backdoors in Object Detection via Pre-NMS Prediction Distribution Shift
articles.content: Object detection models deployed in safety-critical applications remain vulnerable to backdoor attacks that cause targeted misbehaviors when a hidden trigger is present. Existing detection methods either rely on trigger inversion or exploit architecture-specific assumptions, and critically, representative existing methods fail to generalize reliably to scene-level attacks, where a single trigger induces anomalous behavior across all objects in the scene simultaneously. We present DistScan, a backdoor detection framework based on a simple but previously unexploited observation: backdoor injection systematically shifts a model's pre-NMS prediction class distribution away from its training class frequencies, even on clean inputs without any trigger present. DistScan aggregates intermediate class predictions over a clean validation set and flags a model as backdoored if the resulting distribution deviates significantly from the training class frequencies, requiring no model weight access, no trigger knowledge, and no additional training. Extensive experiments on MS-COCO and PASCAL VOC across two architectures and three scene-level attack scenarios demonstrate that DistScan substantially outperforms existing methods, improving average detection accuracy over the best-performing applicable baseline by 27.32 percentage points.

articles.title: SPK: Eliciting Structured Prior Knowledge for Interpretable Out-of-Distribution Detection in Real-Time Object Detection
articles.content: Object detectors often produce over-confident predictions for objects outside their training categories, leading to so-called out-of-distribution (OoD) hallucinations. Existing approaches for detecting or mitigating such hallucinations typically either construct scoring functions directly over learned object detector representations or modify the object detector itself to suppress hallucination emergence. However, the latent priors implicitly encoded in these representations remain largely unexplored and have not been explicitly decoded for OoD detection. To uncover and exploit these latent priors, we propose Structured Prior Knowledge (SPK), a hallucination-oriented framework that explicitly elicits OoD-relevant priors from pretrained object detectors. Specifically, SPK leverages in-distribution data and hallucination-inducing samples as diagnostic supervision to elicit part-level semantic concepts underlying object detector decision-making, rather than using them merely for rejection or object detector adaptation. The elicited semantic priors are further integrated with geometric and contextual priors to form a compact five-dimensional SPK representation for OoD detection. Extensive experiments across diverse object detector architectures and multiple OoD benchmarks demonstrate that SPK achieves state-of-the-art OoD detection. Our findings reveal that pretrained object detectors already encode substantially richer latent knowledge than is typically exploited for OoD detection. More importantly, this knowledge can be explicitly elicited and organized into a compact, structured, and interpretable knowledge space for prediction reliability analysis. This suggests a promising proactive route for improving object detector reliability by explicitly uncovering and leveraging latent priors. Code and data are available at: https://gricad-gitlab.univ-grenoble-alpes.fr/dnn-safety/spk

articles.title_zh: SPK: 实时对象检测中用于可解释的分布外检测的 结构化前知识
articles.content_zh: 物体探测器经常对其训练类别外的物体产生过度自信的预测,导致所谓的外分泌(OoD)幻觉. 探测或减轻这种幻觉的现有方法通常要么直接在所学物体探测器的表示上构建分分函数,要么修改物体探测器本身来抑制幻觉的出现。 然而,这些表述中隐含的前科基本上仍未被探讨,也没有为OOD检测明确解码. 为了发现和利用这些潜在的前科,我们提出结构化先行知识(SPK),这是一个以幻觉为导向的框架,明确从预先训练过的物体探测器中引出OOOD相关前科. 具体来说,SPK利用分布中的数据和诱发幻觉的样本作为诊断监督,引出部分层次的语义概念,作为物体探测器决策的基础,而不是仅仅用于排斥或物体探测器的适应. 被引出语义前科进一步与几何和上下文前科相融合,形成紧凑的五维SPK代表来进行OOD检测. 跨越不同物体探测器架构和多个OoD基准的广泛实验表明,SPK实现了最先进的OOD探测. 我们的发现显示,经过预先训练的物体探测器已经编码了比通常用于OOD探测的更丰富的潜在知识。 更重要的是,这种知识可以被明确引出,并组织成一个紧凑、有结构和可解释的知识空间来进行预测可靠性分析。 这表明,通过明确发现和利用潜在的前科,提高物体探测器的可靠性是一个很有希望的主动途径。 守则和数据见:https://gricad-gitlab.univ-grenoble-alpes.fr/dnn-security/spk。

articles.title: Subgroup performance analysis of adaptation strategies for chest X-ray foundation models
articles.content: Foundation models are increasingly adapted for downstream medical imaging tasks, yet the influence of the chosen adaptation strategy on subgroup fairness remains poorly understood. We investigate how three parameter-efficient adaptation techniques, including linear heads on the raw CLS token, an MLP, and an attention-pooling module over multi-layer patch features, affect both pathology classification performance and subgroup disparities when applied to the frozen Rad-DINO chest X-ray encoder. Using MIMIC-CXR, we evaluate eight pathologies across race, sex, and imaging-view subgroups on a prevalence-preserving, demographically balanced test set, and additionally probe how strongly each adapter encodes protected attributes. We find that attention pooling achieves the strongest overall discriminative performance and encodes attributes, particularly race, most strongly, but that improved overall performance does not consistently reduce subgroup disparities. Notably, stronger attribute encoding did not correspond to larger disparities: early network layers encoded race most weakly yet produced the largest subgroup performance gaps. Exploring different attention-pooling layer combinations further revealed no consistent relationship between the layers pooled, attribute encoding strength, and subgroup fairness. Our results indicate that richer, more expressive representations can improve accuracy while leaving fairness implications task-dependent and unpredictable, which must be assessed directly and per-task rather than inferred from encoding strength or overall performance alone.

articles.title_zh: 胸X射线基础模型适应战略分组绩效分析
articles.content_zh: 基础模型日益适应下游的医学成像任务,然而所选择的适应战略对分组公平性的影响仍然不甚了解. 我们调查了三种参数高效的适应技术,包括原始CLS符号上的线性头,一个MLP,以及多层补丁特性上的注意力集成模块,这些技术如何在被应用到冷冻的拉德-DINO胸X射线编码器时,既影响病理分类性能,也影响分组差异. 使用MIMIC-CXR,我们评估了八个跨种族、性别和成像-视觉分组的病理情况,这些病理情况涉及一个流行性保存、人口平衡的测试集,并另外探究每个适配器如何强烈地编码受保护的属性。 我们发现,集中注意力能够实现最强的整体歧视性表现,并编码属性,特别是种族特征,但总体表现的改善并没有持续地减少分组差距. 值得注意的是,更强的属性编码并不对应更大的差异:早期的网络层编码种族最弱,但却产生了最大的分组性能差距. 探索不同的注意力集成层组合进一步揭示出各层集合,属性编码强度,分组公平之间没有一致的关系. 我们的结果表明,更丰富、更具表现力的表述可以提高准确性,同时使公平影响取决于任务和不可预测,必须直接和按任务评估,而不是仅从编码实力或总体业绩中推断。

articles.title: ReWEIGH the Evidence: Calibrating Token-Level Ordinal Visual Evidence to Mitigate Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) often hallucinate, generating content that the input image does not support. Preventing such content during decoding calls for a candidate-specific measure of how strongly the image supports the token under consideration. The model's visual-token states offer a natural source of this evidence because projecting each state through the output head reveals which vocabulary items that position favors. These position-wise readouts cannot be pooled directly because their probability magnitudes are not comparable across visual positions. Vocabulary ranks provide a scale-invariant basis for pooling, but tokens still differ systematically in their typical rank-based evidence. We propose ReWEIGH, a training-free decoding intervention that aggregates these ranks across visual positions and compares each candidate with a token-specific reference estimated from unlabeled images. At inference, ReWEIGH caches the image evidence during prefill and applies a bounded penalty only to candidates that fall below their reference. On four 7B backbones, ReWEIGH reduces hallucinated object mentions by up to 21.3% while largely preserving or improving descriptive and general performance. With evidence cached, the average added latency is 1.33% per token, and the reductions extend across six architecture families to 32B parameters.

articles.title_zh: ReWEIGH 证据:校正Token-Level 常规视觉证据,以缓解大视觉-语言模型中的幻觉
articles.content_zh: 大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)经常产生幻觉,生成输入图像不支持的内容. 在解码过程中防止这种内容,需要针对候选人具体衡量图像如何有力地支持正在审议的标志。 该模型的可视化键状态提供了这种证据的自然来源,因为通过输出头投射出每个状态会揭示哪些词汇项处于偏好位置. 这些位置读取无法直接集合,因为它们的概率大小在视觉位置之间并不具有可比性。 词汇分级为集合提供了规模变化不一的基础,但符号在典型的分级证据上仍然系统性地有差异. 我们提议ReWEIGH,一种无培训的解码干预,将这些排名汇总到不同视觉位置上,并将每个候选人与从未贴标签的图像中估计的具体符号参考进行比较。 推论,REWEGH在预填时会缓存图像证据,并且只对低于参考标准的候选人实施有限度的处罚. 在4个7B骨干上,REWEIGH将幻觉物体的提及减少21.3%,同时在很大程度上保留或改进描述性和一般性能. 证据被缓存后,平均增加的耐久性为每令牌1.33%,削减范围由6个建筑家族扩大到32B参数.

articles.title: GS-VLA: Plug-and-Play Viewpoint Canonicalization for Frozen VLA Policies via Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: This paper proposes a lightweight, plug-and-play framework that improves robustness to viewpoint shifts in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies without policy retraining. To our knowledge, this is the first approach to directly leverage 3D Gaussian-based novel-view synthesis for observation-space adaptation in VLA policies. Current VLA performance relies on the implicit assumption that training and deployment camera configurations are identical. Our experiments show that even a small displacement of the camera mount can reduce the success rate on the LIBERO benchmark from about 90% to about 10% in the worst case. Prior approaches, such as large-scale fine-tuning or generative data augmentation, are computationally expensive and risk catastrophic forgetting. To address this, viewpoint shifts are reformulated as a localized novel-view synthesis problem. Under a Locality assumption, that camera perturbations remain within a small bounded region relative to the workspace, viewpoint normalization reduces to a scene- and policy-independent disocclusion task. Our work implements this idea with a 4M-parameter 3D-Gaussian canonicalizer prepended to a frozen VLA policy. Without modifying policy weights, GS-VLA improves performance across three orthogonal axes: (1) Policy architectures, (2) Unseen task suites, and (3) Perturbation scales. These results show that a lightweight visual module can recover a large fraction of the performance lost under viewpoint shift, without policy retraining.

articles.title_zh: GS-VLA:通过高斯平板电脑为冻结的VLA政策提供插头和-Play视图点
articles.content_zh: 本文提出了一个轻量级、插座式和游戏式的框架,在不进行政策再培训的情况下,改善对愿景-语言-行动政策转变的看法。 据我们所知,这是第一个直接利用以3D高斯为主的小说-视野合成的方法,用于在甚高法政策中进行观测-空间适应. 目前VLA的性能依赖于培训和部署相机配置完全相同的隐含假设. 我们的实验表明,即使相机上架小幅移动,在最坏的情况下,LIBERO基准上的成功率也会从大约90%降低到大约10%. 以往的方法,如大规模微调或基因数据增强,在计算上费用高昂,有可能造成灾难性的遗忘。 为了解决这一问题,观点转变被重新定义为本地化的新观点综合问题。 根据局部性的假设,相对于工作空间而言,相机扰动仍停留在一个狭小的界限内,观点正常化将沦为一种独立于现场和政策的隔离任务。 我们的工作是用一个4M参数的3D - Gausian罐头 来落实这个想法 准备一个冻结的VLA政策 GS-VLA在不修改政策权重的情况下,改进了三个正交轴的性能: (1) 政策结构; (2) 不明任务包;和(3) 扰动天平。 这些结果表明,一个轻量级视觉模块可以恢复在视线转变下损失的很大一部分性能,而不进行政策再培训。

articles.title: When Two Tracers Disagree: An Investigation of Multimodal Fusion for Clinical PET/CT Segmentation
articles.content: PSMA and FDG PET/CT visualise complementary biological information in prostate cancer. Combining both tracers could capture heterogeneous tumour phenotypes that may be missed by either alone, yet there is no consensus on effective deep learning architectures for fusing these modalities. We evaluated multimodal image-fusion strategies for automatic whole-body PET/CT lesion segmentation to estimate total tumour burden. Using the public DEEP-PSMA Challenge dataset, we trained tracer-specific 3D nnU-Net baselines and compared (i) early fusion with a single encoder and one decoder (OEOD) or two decoders (OETD), and (ii) intermediate fusion via a dual-encoder cross-attention U-Net (DECA-UNet). Tracer-specific baselines performed strongly (PSMA Dice = 0.93; FDG = 0.81). Fusion yielded mixed results: OEOD produced a combined Dice of 0.90 (on an easier, non-tracer-specific task), whilst the tracer-specific fusion models reached PSMA/FDG = 0.69/0.64 (OETD) and 0.76/0.57 (DECA-UNet). Whilst fusion often provided reasonable PSMA segmentation, FDG performance degraded and no strategy consistently exceeded the single-tracer baselines. Under the evaluated setting, tracer-specific models remain the stronger baseline; clinically useful gains from multimodal fusion will likely require architectures that better preserve tracer specific representations. Our code is available at: https://github.com/JackJ3636/DEEP_PSMA_code

articles.title_zh: 当两个追踪器出现分歧时:对临床PET/CT分化的多式组合的调查
articles.content_zh: PSMA和FDG PET/CT可视化前列腺癌中的互补生物信息. 将两种示踪剂结合起来,可以捕捉到单方可能忽略的多种肿瘤酚类,然而,对于有效的深层学习结构来消除这些模式却没有达成共识。 我们评价了自动全身PET/CT损伤分解的多模式成像融合战略,以估计肿瘤总负担。 使用公共的DEEP-PSMA挑战数据集,我们培训了针对追踪器的3D nnU-Net基线,并比较了(一) 早期聚变,使用单一编码器和一分解码器(OEOD)或两分解码器(OETD),(二) 通过双分解码器交叉调取U-Net(DECA-UNet)进行中间聚变。 跟踪器特定基线的绩效良好(PSMA Dice=0.93;FDG=0.81)。 聚变结果好坏参半:OEOD产生的综合Dice为0.90(在较简单、非Tracer特定的任务上),而微量聚变模式则达到PSMA/FDG=0.69/0.64(OETD)和0.76/0.57(DECA-UNet)。 虽然聚变往往能提供合理的聚合物分解,但FDG的性能却退化了,没有任何战略始终超过单倍基线。 在经过评价的设定中,针对追踪器的模型仍然是更强有力的基线;在临床上,从多式联运聚变中获得的有益收益可能要求结构更好地保存追踪器的具体表述。 我们的代码可见于:https://github.com/JackJ3636/DEEP_PSMA_code

articles.title: LT-Mem: Volatility-Aware Spatio-Temporal Memory for Lifelong Scene Understanding
articles.content: Long-term robot operation in evolving environments requires object-level understanding that persists across repeated revisits. Existing systems either overwrite history to maintain an up-to-date map or store semantic snapshots without consistent cross-session object identity, resulting in temporal amnesia: the systematic loss of object history that prevents answering queries such as "Where has the green chair been across all sessions?" We propose LT-Mem, a volatility-aware memory evolution framework that unifies spatially aligned instance-level 3D perception with volatility-conditioned temporal reasoning. First, a multi-session SLAM backbone provides spatially aligned per-object observations across sessions. Second, a reasoning layer governs how object memory evolves: deterministic evidence scoring preserves cross-session identity, and a volatility-aware policy selects among overwrite, hold, and multi-hypothesis actions based on each object's dynamics. Third, the resulting Tri-Memory structure (Live, Delta, Meta) preserves both current states and event histories, enabling longitudinal object-centric reasoning. We further introduce LT-VQA, a dataset and evaluation suite comprising multi-session recordings, persistent identity annotations, and temporal QA pairs. Experiments show that LT-Mem consistently outperforms baselines across all metrics while consuming an order of magnitude fewer tokens, and ablations confirm that gains are driven by the structured memory architecture rather than LLM capacity.

articles.title_zh: LT- Mem: 活泼- Aware Spatio- 生命场景理解的时空记忆
articles.content_zh: 在不断变化的环境中进行长期机器人操作,需要通过反复重访来坚持对物体层面的理解。 现有系统要么覆盖历史以维护最新的地图,要么存储语义快照而不具有一致的相交对象身份,导致时间性失忆: 系统性地丢失了物体历史,无法回答诸如"绿色椅子在所有会话中在哪里?"这样的询问. 我们提出LT-Mem,一个可起伏感知的内存演化框架,以可起伏性条件的时间推理统一空间对齐的实例级3D感知. 首先,一个多会场的SLAM主干网提供跨会间空间对接的每个对象观测. 其次,一个推理层支配着对象内存的演化方式:确定性的证据评分保留了跨会话的特性,一个可波动-意识到的政策根据每个对象的动态在覆盖,持有,以及多假说动作中选择. 第三,由此产生的"三记忆"结构(Live, Delta, Meta)既保留了当前状态,也保存了事件历史,使得纵向的以对象为中心的推理成为可能. 我们还引入了LT-VQA,这是一个数据集和评价套件,由多会场录音、持续身份说明和时间性QA对组成。 实验显示,LT-Mem在消耗数量级的代号的同时,始终超越所有度量的基线,而活化证实,收益是由结构化的内存结构而不是LLM能力驱动的。

articles.title: Generalized Audio-Driven Synthesis of Precise Drummer Motion
articles.content: Music-driven character animation enables and enhances transformative applications in entertainment and interactive education. However, synthesizing realistic drumming motion from audio remains challenging due to the inherent tension between high-acceleration dynamics and the need for extreme spatial-temporal precision. Existing approaches, often reliant on motion matching or MIDI input, struggle with generalizing to diverse real-world audio. Moreover, the field lacks standardized evaluation metrics capable of distinguishing precise drumming from noisy motion. In this paper, we introduce a generative diffusion framework featuring a dual-objective loss function that decouples skeletal integrity from drumstick precision, thus enabling centimeter-level stick precision without sacrificing natural body dynamics. Additionally, leveraging our own dataset and data augmentation strategy, the model generalizes to non-curated, in-the-wild audio. To rigorously evaluate performance, we propose two novel metrics: an impact-to-target distance to quantify spatial precision and an audio-motion correlation score to assess temporal alignment. Our quantitative analysis and user studies demonstrate that our system generates high-quality motion that is often indistinguishable from ground-truth performances.

articles.title_zh: 精密鼓动的通用音频驱动合成
articles.content_zh: 音乐驱动的人物动画能够并加强娱乐和互动教育中的转型应用. 然而,从音频合成现实的鼓动运动仍然具有挑战性,因为高加速动力学与极端空间-时空精度需要之间的内在矛盾. 现有的方法,往往依赖于运动匹配或MIDI输入,难以概括到各种现实世界的音频。 此外,外地缺乏能够区分准确鼓动和吵闹运动的标准评价尺度。 在本文中,我们引入了基因扩散框架,其特点是双目标损失功能,将骨骼完整性与鼓棒精度脱钩,从而在不牺牲自然体动力的情况下,使厘米级的精度得以实现. 此外,利用我们自己的数据集和数据增强战略,该模型一般化为非精密的、无线的音频。 为了严格评价业绩,我们提出了两个新的衡量标准:一个是影响与目标之间的距离,以量化空间精确度;另一个是音频-运动相关性的分数,以评估时间吻合。 我们的定量分析和用户研究表明,我们的系统产生高质量的运动,往往与地面真实表现无法区分。

articles.title: Bernstein-Vazirani Networks: Quantum Machine Learning by Interference
articles.content: We introduce Bernstein-Vazirani Networks (BVNs), a non-variational quantum machine learning framework that leverages quantum interference for supervised learning, demonstrated on vision and representation learning tasks. In their standard form, BVNs follow the principle of quantum Fourier sampling: labelled data are placed in superposition and interfered in the Fourier basis to extract globally informative features. We then define generalised BVNs that enable interference in problem-adapted bases, yielding more expressive models under the same measurement budget as in the standard setting. BVNs achieve universal function approximation through (over)complete interference bases, while training of BVNs is gradient-free. Experiments on synthetic and real-world classification tasks, as well as implicit image representation, show strong generalisation capabilities and competitive performance with classical and quantum baselines.

articles.title_zh: 伯恩斯坦-瓦齐拉尼 网络:量子机器通过干扰学习
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍Bernstein-Vazirani Networks(BVNs),这是一个非变量量子机学习框架,利用量子干扰进行有监督的学习,在视觉和代表性学习任务上演示. BVNs在其标准形式上遵循量子Fourier采样原则:标签数据被置于叠加位置,并干扰Fourier基础以提取全球信息特征. 然后,我们界定了允许干涉适应问题的基础的通用BVN,在与标准设定相同的计量预算下产生更多的表达模型. BVN通过(超)完整的干扰基实现通用函数近似,而BVN的训练则无梯度. 关于合成和现实世界分类任务的实验,以及隐含的图像表现,显示出强大的泛化能力和具有古典和量子基线的竞争性能.

articles.title: USR-Drive: Unified Driving Scene Representation via Joint Denoising of 3D Gaussians and Boxes
articles.content: Spatial representation learning for autonomous driving aims to map raw visual signals into structured 3D scene representations, where object-centric bounding boxes and rendering-oriented 3D primitives (\eg, 3D Gaussians) serve as two distinct yet highly complementary levels for scene understanding. Existing methods typically treat dynamic reconstruction and instance-level perception as separate tasks, despite their shared goal of estimating the underlying 3D world state. As a result, dynamic reconstruction is under-constrained while 3D detection lacks geometric grounding. To address this gap, we propose USR-Drive, a unified conditional generative framework that, given only posed multi-view driving videos, jointly recovers dense dynamic geometry and instance-level object layouts within a shared scene representation. Specifically, USR-Drive represents dense Gaussian primitives and sparse 3D bounding boxes as two aligned latent token streams and jointly denoises them with a unified multi-modal diffusion Transformer. Unlike prior paradigms that use boxes as external conditions or predict them with detached modules, USR-Drive treats them as mutually constrained state variables with a Unified Positional Encoding (UPE) that aligns heterogeneous tokens within a shared metric spatiotemporal coordinate. Via such unified representation and generative framework, the two modalities reinforce each other: geometry supplies dense metric evidence for box prediction, while boxes provide instance-level structural priors that help preserve spatial consistency and reduce ambiguity in sequential 3D geometric representation. Our approach successfully delivers state-of-the-art results for both dynamic reconstruction and 3D detection on the nuScenes and VKitti datasets.

articles.title_zh: USR-Drive:通过3D Gaussians和Boxes联合登基来统一驾驶场景代表制
articles.content_zh: 用于自主驾驶的空间表现学习旨在将原始视觉信号映射到结构化的3D场景表现中,其中以对象为中心的边框和渲染为方向的3D原始物(\eg,3D Gaussians)作为两个不同但高度互补的层次,用于场景理解. 现有方法通常将动态重建和实例层面的认知作为单独的任务处理,尽管它们的共同目标是估计基本的3D世界状态。 因此,动态重建不足,而3D探测缺乏几何地面. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出USR-Drive,一个统一的有条件的基因框架,由于这个框架只提供了多视图驱动视频,所以在共享场景代表中共同恢复密集的动态几何和实例级对象布局. 具体地说,USR-Drive代表稠密的高斯原始体和稀疏的3D边框作为两条对齐的潜伏符号流,并用统一的多模式扩散变形器共同使它们脱落. 与以往将框作为外部条件或用分离模块预测其的范式不同,USR-Drive将框作为相互约束的状态变量对待,其统一定位编码(UPE)在共享的公尺spatiotoporal坐标内将异形符号对齐. 通过这种统一的表达和基因框架,两种模式相辅相成:几何为箱预测提供密集的计量证据,而箱提供实例一级的结构前缀,有助于保持空间一致性,减少相继的3D几何表达中的模糊性。 我们的方法成功地在nuScenes和VKitti数据集上提供了动态重建和3D检测的最新结果。

articles.title: Counterfactual Contrastive Analysis
articles.content: Visual Counterfactual Explanations (VCEs) aim to explain image classifiers by generating minimally edited and realistic versions of an input image that change the classifier's prediction. Existing VCE methods are inherently classifier-dependent and therefore susceptible to classifier biases and failure modes, such as sensitivity to shortcut features and calibration errors. In this paper, we propose a classifier-free approach for visual counterfactual generation based on Contrastive Analysis (CA). Given two datasets corresponding to different classes (e.g., healthy and patients), we disentangle the generative factors that are common across the two datasets from those that are salient to each dataset, and generate counterfactual images by swapping only the salient factors. By operating directly on data distributions rather than decision boundaries, our method provides model-agnostic VCEs that are less sensitive to classifier biases. Our approach leverages the high-quality synthesis and well-structured latent space of StyleGAN2. We use the feature space F, instead than the usual W-space, to improve detail preservation. Unlike conventional CA approaches, which typically assume salient factors in only one dataset, we introduce an adapted framework and loss functions for VCE that allow multiple salient factors in each dataset. We evaluate our method on three medical imaging datasets and demonstrate superior counterfactual generation quality compared to existing approaches.

articles.title_zh: 反事实对比分析
articles.content_zh: 视觉反事实解释(VCE)旨在通过生成一个最小编辑且现实的输入图像版本来解释图像分类器,从而改变分类器的预测. 现有的VCE方法本质上是依赖分类器的,因此容易发生分类偏差和故障模式,例如对快捷键特性的敏感性和校准错误. 在本文中,我们提出基于对比分析(CA)的视觉反事实生成的无分类法. 鉴于两个数据集对应不同类别(如健康与患者),我们从每个数据集的显著数据中分离出两个数据集之间常见的基因因素,并通过仅互换显著因素生成反事实图像. 通过直接在数据分布而不是决定边界上操作,我们的方法提供了模型不可知的对分类者偏差不太敏感的VCE. 我们的方法利用了StyleGAN2的高质量合成和结构完善的潜在空间。 我们利用特色空间F而不是通常的W-空间来改进细节保存. 常规CA方法通常只在一个数据集中假设显著因素,我们与常规CA方法不同的是,我们为VCE引入了一个可允许每个数据集中多个显著因素的适应框架和损失函数. 我们在三个医学成像数据集上评价我们的方法,并显示与现有方法相比,反事实生成质量更高。

articles.title: Orthogonal Polynomial Approximation for Matrix Log Normalization in Global Covariance Pooling
articles.content: Global Covariance Pooling (GCP) improves deep networks by capturing second-order feature statistics, and is especially effective for fine-grained recognition. Because covariance matrices live on the Symmetric Positive Definite (SPD) manifold, a normalization step is required before the Euclidean classifier. The faithful choice is the matrix logarithm (MLN-COV), which maps the SPD manifold to its tangent space; in practice it was abandoned in favour of the matrix square root because its eigendecomposition-based gradient is numerically unstable. We show that this instability is an artifact of computing the logarithm spectrally, not of the logarithm itself. Approximating the logarithm with finite polynomials in the covariance matrix removes the eigendecomposition from both passes: every operation becomes a General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM), the gradient stays bounded on the spectral support of the pre-normalized covariance, and the unstable 1/(lambda_i-lambda_j) term never appears. The key ingredient is a mean-eigenvalue pre-normalization that centres the spectrum near 1, away from the singularity of log, with a scalar post-compensation that returns the singular part of log(A) in closed form. Our recommended normalizer is a degree-8 Chebyshev expansion evaluated by a three-term matrix recurrence, with a matching reverse recurrence for the backward pass; Legendre, Laguerre, Taylor and Pade expansions are studied as controls that isolate the roles of the basis and of the target function. On three fine-grained benchmarks and ImageNet-1k the decomposition-free logarithm is both faster and more accurate than the spectral logarithm and than the square-root approximations it replaces, and at matched basis and degree the log target beats the square-root target, confirming that the gain comes from the faithful Riemannian map rather than from a better polynomial family.

articles.title_zh: 全球共变集合中矩阵逻辑常态化的正统多边形
articles.content_zh: Global Covariance Pooling(GCP)通过捕捉二阶特征统计改进了深层网络,对于精细的识别特别有效. 因为共变矩阵生活在对称正定数(SPD)的倍数上,所以在欧几里得分级器之前需要一个正常化步骤. 忠实的选择是矩阵对数(MLN-COV),它将SPD的多面图映射到它的切换空间;实际上它被弃用而倾向于矩阵平方根,因为其以等分解为基础的梯度在数值上不稳定. 我们显示这种不稳定是光谱计算对数的产物,而不是对数本身的产物。 在共变矩阵中以有限多数表示对数,从两个通道中去除等离子分解:每次操作都成为一般矩阵乘法(GEMM),梯度停留在前常态共变的光谱支持上,不稳定的1/(lambda_i-lambda_j)术语从未出现. 关键成分是中-egenvalue 预常态化,将光谱居中接近1,远离日志的奇异性,在补偿后有一个scalar,以封闭形式返回日志(A)的单数部分. 我们推荐的正常化者是用三期矩阵重现来评价的八度Chebyshev扩展,反向重现落后的通道; Legendre, Laguerre, Taylor和Pade扩展被研究为隔离基础和目标功能作用的控制. 在三个细纹基准和ImageNet-1k上,解析无对数既比光谱对数更快,也比它所取代的平方根近似值更准确,在匹配的基础和程度上,对数目标比平方根目标强,证实收益来自忠实的里曼地图而不是更好的多诺米家族.

articles.title: One-Stage Object Detectors in Autonomous Driving
articles.content: Autonomous vehicles depend on fast and reliable perception systems to detect surrounding vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists, traffic signs, and other road objects in real time. This paper presents a comprehensive survey and analysis of one-stage object detectors for autonomous driving rather than an implementation of a new detection system. The survey reviews the evolution of major one-stage detectors, including YOLOv1, SSD, RetinaNet, EfficientDet, anchor-free detectors such as FCOS and CenterNet, and recent real-time models such as YOLOv10. It compares these architectures through their design choices, feature-fusion strategies, loss functions, deployment trade-offs, and reported benchmark performance. The paper also summarizes commonly used autonomous-driving datasets, evaluation metrics, open challenges, and future research directions. Overall, this survey highlights how one-stage detectors balance speed, accuracy, efficiency, and robustness, while also emphasizing the remaining gap between benchmark results and dependable real-world autonomous-driving performance.

articles.title_zh: 自动驾驶的单层物体探测器
articles.content_zh: 自主车辆依靠快速可靠的感知系统实时检测周边车辆,行人,骑自行车者,交通标志,以及其他道路物体. 本文对单阶段物体探测器进行自主驾驶的综合调查和分析,而不是实施新的探测系统. 调查审查了主要的一级探测器的演变情况,包括YOLOv1,SSD,RetinaNet,高效Det,FCOS和CenterNet等无锚探测器,以及YOLOv10等近期实时模型. 它通过设计选择、特征集成战略、损失功能、部署权衡和报告基准业绩对这些架构进行比较。 文件还总结了常用的自主驾驶数据集、评价衡量标准、公开挑战和未来的研究方向。 总的来说,本调查突出了单阶段探测器如何平衡速度、准确性、效率和稳健性,同时也强调了基准结果与可靠的现实世界自主驾驶性能之间的剩余差距。

articles.title: Autonomous Agricultural Tractor: Integrated Weed Detection and LiDAR Navigation for Precision Paddy Farming
articles.content:
Site-specific weed management in paddy farming offers substantial reductions in herbicide use over conventional broadcast spraying, but field deployment has been limited by three persistent challenges: robust crop-row navigation under canopy where GNSS degrades, real-time visual discrimination between rice and morphologically diverse weeds, and the asymmetric cost of misclassifying rice as weed, which is irreversible.
  This paper presents AgriNav, an integrated autonomous tractor system built around four ROS-coupled modules: a custom PyTorch reimplementation of WeedDet for rice detection, a parallel lightweight 1.68M-parameter CNN-FPN variant with asymmetric class weighting, an inverted-logic discrimination module that protects the rice class through a hardcoded confidence-gate veto, and a 6-state constant-velocity-turn-rate Extended Kalman Filter fusing GNSS, IMU, and wheel odometry with three-level outage bridging. Our primary system-level contribution is a four-mechanism LiDAR-camera fusion bridge that uses the navigation LiDAR for region-of-interest constraint, world-coordinate projection, ground-plane filtering, and bidirectional confidence fusion at zero additional hardware cost.
  Simulation experiments demonstrate continuous position tracking through a 20-second GNSS outage, crop row detection confidence above 0.9 throughout operation, and rice-detection confidences from 0.32 to 0.95 across paddy, aerial, and post-flood imagery. The LiDAR ROI constraint reduces detection inference region by an estimated 30 to 50 percent.

articles.title_zh: 自主农业拖拉机:精密派迪农场综合杂草检测和LiDAR导航
articles.content_zh:
稻田种植中针对具体地点的杂草管理比传统广播喷洒大大减少了除草剂的使用,但实地部署受到三个持续挑战的限制:在全球导航卫星系统退化的树冠下进行强力的作物排行导航,在水稻和形态多样性杂草之间进行实时视觉区分,以及将水稻误分类为杂草的不对称成本,这是不可逆转的。
本文介绍了AgriNav,这是围绕四个ROS连锁模块建造的综合自主拖拉机系统:一个定制的用于水稻探测的WeedDet的PyTorch重置装置,一个平行的轻量级1.68M参数的CNN-FPN变体,一个通过硬码置信门否决权保护水稻级的倒置式歧视模块,以及一个6级恒定速-转速扩展卡尔曼滤波器安装GNSS、IMU和带有三级断层桥的轮对。 我们系统一级的首要贡献是一座四机型的LiDAR-camera聚变桥,该桥利用导航LiDAR进行利益区域约束,世界坐标投影,地面飞机过滤,以及双向信心聚变,零额外硬件成本.
模拟实验表明,通过20秒的全球导航卫星系统故障、整个运行期间的作物排探测信心高于0.9,以及稻谷、空中和洪水后图像从0.32到0.95的稻谷探测信心,持续跟踪位置。 LiDAR ROI限制使检测推断区减少约30%至50%。

articles.title: Mise-en-Scène: Implicit Layout Emergence in Diffusion Transformers for Human-AI Design Co-Creation
articles.content: Automating graphic design synthesis from user-provided elements requires both a coherent overall composition and the exact preservation of each asset. Existing methods predict a layout as explicit bounding-box coordinates with a language model and then paste the assets into it, which separates spatial planning from visual synthesis and tends to produce rigid, mis-scaled compositions. We instead ask whether the layout can emerge implicitly inside a pretrained image-editing diffusion transformer. We present Mise-en-Scène, a two-stage framework. In the first stage, a diffusion transformer adapted with a small, knockout-selected LoRA drafts a complete design in which the arrangement of the elements emerges jointly with the rendered canvas. In the second stage, a deterministic match-and-place step moves the original high-resolution assets to the drafted positions, which guarantees exact asset fidelity and yields an editable, layered design that a designer can keep refining rather than a flat image. Notably, a minimal adaptation of the pretrained transformer already suffices, without the specialized conditioning machinery commonly introduced for multi-element generation. On the large-scale PrismLayersPlus benchmark, the designs produced by Mise-en-Scène are the closest to the ground truth in perceived quality among all compared methods, by a wide margin over both an LLM layout planner and a specialized layout transformer, while our match-and-place stage bridges the remaining fidelity gap to the ground-truth composites.

articles.title_zh: Mise-en-Scène:用于人类-AI设计共创的传播变形器中的隐形布局
articles.content_zh: 从用户提供的元素中实现图形设计合成自动化,既需要连贯的整体构成,也需要准确保存每项资产。 现有方法预测一个布局为带有语言模型的明晰的边框坐标,然后将资产粘贴到其中,将空间规划与视觉合成区分开来,并倾向于产生刚性,错位的成分. 我们却问,布局是否能够隐含地出现在预先训练的图像编辑传播变压器中。 我们提出一个分为两个阶段的Scène角。 在第一阶段,一个用小型的、淘汰型的LORA设计的扩散变压器起草了一个完整的设计,其中元素的安排与制成的帆布一起出现。 在第二阶段,一个确定性匹配和位置的阶梯将原始的高分辨率资产移动到已起草的职位上,这保证了准确的资产忠诚,并产生了可编辑的,分层的设计,设计者可以保持精炼而不是平整的图像. 值得注意的是,对预先训练过的变压器进行最低限度的改造就足够了,没有通常为多元组装而引进的专门调节机械。 在PrismLayersPlus的大规模基准上,由Mise-en-Scène制作的设计最接近于所有比较方法中感知质量的地面真伪,在LLM布局规划器和专用布局变压器上都有很大的差幅,而我们的匹配和位置级则将剩余忠实差距与地面真伪复合材料连接起来。

articles.title: GrabVG: Graph-Attentive Binding for Visual Grounding in UAV Imagery
articles.content: Visual grounding in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) imagery aims to localize a target object in complex bird's-eye-view scenes according to a natural language description. However, the abundance of small, densely distributed, and visually similar objects creates high visual redundancy, while repetitive local configurations give rise to strong topological ambiguity. Existing approaches mainly focus on visual--language feature alignment or dense contextual interaction, yet they struggle to distinguish subtle inter-instance differences and effectively exploit spatial topological structures, leading to inaccurate grounding in highly crowded scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose $\textbf{GrabVG}$, a novel visual grounding framework inspired by human visual search. GrabVG explicitly decomposes grounding into two sequential stages: $\textit{preattentive hypothesis search}$ and $\textit{graph-attentive feature binding}$. Specifically, we first generate a compact set of reliable object hypotheses through distillation-guided proposal induction and text-aware hypothesis filtering, substantially reducing background distractions and semantic mismatches. These hypotheses are then organized into a sparse graph, where language-guided intra-instance visual cues and inter-instance topological relationships are jointly bound and propagated via graph attention, enabling efficient spatial reasoning and accurate target localization. Extensive experiments on AerialVG and AerialSense show that GrabVG achieves a favorable accuracy--speed trade-off, reaching 67.31$\%$ and 80.34$\%$ Acc@0.5 and outperforming the corresponding baselines by 10.55 and 8.76 percentage points, respectively.

articles.title_zh: GrabVG: 用于在无人驾驶飞行器成像器中进行视觉定位的图形加载
articles.content_zh: 在无人驾驶飞行器(UAV)图像中可视化地着陆,目的是根据自然语言描述,将目标物体定位于复杂的鸟眼视觉场景中. 然而,小的,密集的分布,以及视觉上相似的物体的丰富性造成了较高的视觉冗余,而重复的局部配置则引起强烈的地形模糊. 现有方法主要侧重于视觉语言特征的对接或密集的上下文互动,然而它们却努力区分微妙的内在差异,并有效利用空间地形结构,导致在高度拥挤的情景中不准确的搁浅. 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议使用$\textbf{GrabVG}$,这是人类视觉搜索启发的新视觉地面框架。 GrabVG 明确将地面分解为两个相继阶段: $\ textit{ preattentive system search}$和 $\ textit{graph-attentive 功能绑定}$. 具体地说,我们首先通过蒸馏制导的建议诱导和文本感知假说过滤,产生一套紧凑的可靠对象假说,大大减少了背景分散和语义错配. 然后将这些假设编成一个稀疏的图表,其中语言引导的内置视觉提示和内置的地形关系通过图表的注意来联合捆绑和传播,从而能够高效的空间推理和准确的目标本地化. AirVG和AirSense的广泛实验显示,GrabVG实现了有利的精度-速度比对,达到67.31美元和80.34美元。 Acc@0.5和比相应基线分别高出10.55和8.76个百分点。

articles.title: ForeSightGuide: An Anticipatory Framework toward Accurate and Low-Redundancy Guidance for the Visually Impaired
articles.content: Electronic travel aids are pivotal for the independent mobility of the visually impaired. While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer rich environmental understanding, they often suffer from excessive false positives in dynamic scenarios, leading to cognitive overload. To address this, we present ForeSightGuide, an anticipatory assistive guidance framework that couples semantic scene understanding with predictive hazard assessment. Unlike reactive systems, ForeSightGuide leverages the reasoning capabilities of VLMs to anticipate obstacle motion, effectively filtering out non-threatening objects to provide concise, actionable guidance. To validate our approach, we introduce a novel dataset captured in complex, dynamic real-world traffic scenes, designed to benchmark predictive capabilities. Extensive experiments on both public benchmarks and our proposed dataset demonstrate that ForeSightGuide achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, it significantly mitigates information overload by reducing redundant alerts to 0.299 per guidance output while maintaining a low missed-hazard rate of 0.112, proving its efficacy for safe walking assistance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 前瞻指南:视觉障碍者准确和低风险指导的预期框架
articles.content_zh: 电子旅行辅助工具对视力受损者的独立行动至关重要。 虽然Visual-Langage Models(VLMs)提供了丰富的环境理解,但他们在动态情景中经常遭受过度的虚假阳性,导致认知超载. 为了解决这一问题,我们提出了 " 前瞻指南 " ,这是一个预测性辅助性指导框架,夫妻双方用预测性危害评估来理解场景。 与反应系统不同,ForeSightGuide利用VLMs的推理能力来预测障碍运动,有效地过滤出无威胁物体,提供简洁,可操作的指导. 为了验证我们的方法,我们引入了一个在复杂,动态的现实世界交通场景中捕捉到的新数据组,旨在基准预测能力. 对公共基准和我们拟议数据集的广泛试验表明, " 前瞻指南 " 实现了最先进的性能。 值得注意的是,它将冗余警报减少到0.299次/次指导产出,同时保持0.112的低误差率,从而大大缓解信息超载,证明了它对安全步行援助的功效.

articles.title: X-LMC: Cross-View Spatiotemporal Collateral Circulation Scoring from DSA
articles.content: Digital subtraction angiography (DSA) is the reference standard for leptomeningeal collateral (LMC) assessment, providing critical prognostic insights to guide secondary treatment strategies, neurorehabilitation planning, and retrospective stroke research. However, clinical LMC grading via the ASITN/SIR scale relies on manual, highly variable visual inspection. We introduce X-LMC, a spatiotemporal framework for automated collateral scoring from time-resolved biplane DSA. The proposed architecture encodes spatial frame representations through a DINOv2 backbone, fuses orthogonal projections via a token-level cross-view attention module, and models representations of contrast bolus dynamics using a recurrent network architecture. We evaluate our framework on a multicenter dataset of 134 patients with M1-segment occlusions. In a 5-fold cross-validation setting, X-LMC yields higher point estimates than static architectures and spatiotemporal baselines adapted from related angiographic tasks, achieving a Quadratic Weighted Kappa (QWK) of 0.398 (vs. 0.322) and a dichotomized macro-F1 score of 0.711 (vs. 0.663) against the best-performing baseline. X-LMC performance also aligns with the observed clinical inter-rater agreement (QWK: 0.314). As the first DSA study attempting to automate LMC scoring, we demonstrate that multi-view temporal deep learning can capture collateral-specific contrast kinetics. Ultimately, these benchmarks delineate the clinical ambiguities and achievable performance boundaries of automated ASITN/SIR grading, establishing a reproducible foundation for objective hemodynamic phenotyping in stroke cohorts. Code is available at https://github.com/maedehafezi/X-LMC.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: X-LMC:来自DSA的跨视星等 Spatiotemporal 环流分红
articles.content_zh: 数字减法血管造影学(DSA)是勒普特敏化附属物(LMC)评估的参考标准,为指导二级治疗策略,神经康复规划和追溯性中风研究提供了批判性的预知. 然而,临床LMC通过ASITN/SIR尺度进行分级,依赖于人工的,高度可变的视觉检查. 我们引入了X-LMC,一个从时空解析的双机DSA自动分数的spatiotimporal框架. 拟议架构通过DINOv2主干线编码空间框架表示,通过符号级交叉视图注意模块的引信正交投影,以及使用经常性网络结构的对比波卢斯动态的模型表示. 我们用一个多中心数据集来评估我们的框架,该数据集由134名患有M1区隔离症的病人组成。 在5倍的交叉验证设定中,X-LMC比静态架构和根据相关血管学任务改编的瞬间基线产生更高的点估计值,实现四极卫视Kappa(QWK)0.398(vs.0.322),二极卫视宏F1得分0.711(vs. 0.663),比最佳表现基线. X-LMC的性能也与观察到的临床间反应协议(QWK:0.314. 作为第一次试图将LMC评分自动化的DSA研究,我们证明了多视时间深度学习可以捕捉到附带特定对比动力学. 归根结底,这些基准划定了ASITN/SIR自动定级的临床模糊性和可实现性能界限,为中风组群的客观血压形成可复制的基础。 代码见https://github.com/meedehafezi/X-LMC。

articles.title: Uncertainty-Aware Art-Historical Dating with Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Museum and archival datasets do not mirror historical artistic production, but materialize the contingent histories of collecting, preservation, cataloging, and digitization. This has direct consequences for interpreting pretrained image representations: they may appear to encode historical time while actually encoding the institutional conditions under which objects become visible as data. We describe this phenomenon as temporal entanglement and investigate it by formulating artwork dating as an uncertainty-aware regression task over frozen image embeddings. We evaluate several pretrained vision models on a temporally controlled Wikidata corpus of artworks. Our results show that these models contain usable temporal information, with Vision-Language Models (VLMs) outperforming purely visual self-supervised baselines. However, a qualitative analysis indicates that this temporal knowledge is shaped by various biases.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 不确定- 智能艺术- 历史约会与视觉- 语言模型
articles.content_zh: 博物馆和档案数据集不反映历史艺术作品,而是实现收集、保存、编目和数字化的特有历史。 这对解释预加训练的图像表示方式有直接影响:它们可能似乎对历史时间进行编码,同时实际上将物体作为数据可见的体制条件编码。 我们把这种现象描述为时间纠缠,并通过将日期设定为对冷冻图像嵌入的不确定性认识的回归任务来对其进行调查。 我们评价了几个经过预先训练的视觉模型 在一个时间上控制的Wikidata 艺术文集。 我们的结果表明,这些模型包含可用的时间信息,视线语言模型(VLMs)优于纯粹视觉自我监督的基线。 然而,定性分析表明,这种时间知识是由各种偏见形成的。

articles.title: When Simplicity Wins: Bottleneck-Aware Context Modeling for Lightweight Semantic Segmentation
articles.content: Semantic segmentation demands a careful balance between accuracy, efficiency, and scalability, which remains difficult to achieve for high-resolution imagery. Convolutional networks effectively model local patterns but struggle with long-range dependencies, whereas Vision Transformers capture global context at a high computational cost. While recent work largely focuses on encoder design, the bottleneck stage, central to contextual aggregation and information flow, has been relatively overlooked. We propose SiConMo, a lightweight yet effective framework, implemented in two variants: an RGB-only model (SiConMo) and a GME-enhanced variant (SiConMo$_\dagger$). We show that simplicity arises from a key design principle: at very low computational budgets, the bottleneck is the most efficient stage to integrate local and global context. SiConMo integrates three complementary components: a Token Pyramid Extraction Module for hierarchical multi-scale representation, a Transformer-Branched Depthwise Convolution block for bottleneck-aware context modeling, and a Feature Merging Module that preserves spatial structure while enhancing semantic consistency. Extensive experiments on ADE20K, PASCAL Context, Cityscapes, and COCO-Stuff demonstrate that SiConMo achieves a state-of-the-art accuracy-efficiency trade-off among lightweight semantic segmentation models, highlighting simplicity as a powerful design principle.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当简单化 Wins: 轻量语义分解的 Bottleneck- Aware 上下文建模时
articles.content_zh: 语义分解要求精度,效率和可伸缩性之间保持谨慎的平衡,对于高分辨率图像来说,这仍然很难实现. 革命网络有效地模拟当地模式,但与远距离依赖性作斗争,而Vision Transformers则以高昂的计算成本捕捉全球背景。 虽然最近的工作主要侧重于编码器的设计,但对于背景汇总和信息流动来说,瓶颈阶段相对被忽视。 我们提出SiConMo这个轻量级但有效的框架,在两个变体中实施:一个只使用RGB的模型(SiConMo)和一个增强GME的变体(SiConMo$_\dagger$). 我们表明,简洁源自一项关键设计原则:在非常低的计算预算,瓶颈是结合地方和全球环境的最有效阶段。 SiConMo整合了三个互补组件:一个用于分级多尺度表示的托肯金字塔提取模块,一个用于瓶颈-意识上下文建模的变形器-深智组合块,以及一个在增强语义一致性的同时保持空间结构的特性合并模块. 对ADE20K,PASCAL背景,Cityscapes,和COCO-Stuff的广泛实验表明,SiConMo在轻量级语义分解模型中实现了最先进的精度效率权衡,强调简洁是一个强大的设计原则.

articles.title: Frozen DINO Localizes Image Edits Without a Localizer
articles.content: Localized image edits can change a photograph's meaning while leaving most of it authentic, so forensic analysis must identify where an edit occurred. We show that patch-level perturbation responses from frozen DINO encoders are themselves localization maps. Training-free Localization of AI-image Edits from patch-token Drift (TRAIL) applies one global Haar perturbation and maps cosine drift between corresponding patch tokens. On 80 source-disjoint CocoGlide test images, TRAIL reaches .903 patch AUROC versus .912 for the mask-supervised Detective SAM; fixed-threshold Dice is .619 versus .709, while an oracle threshold raises TRAIL to .790. Transferred unchanged to Poisson image interpolation, TRAIL reaches .855 AUROC versus .864, showing that the cue persists without a generator. Across sixteen DINO encoders, the best block lies at normalized depth .80-.94. Global context matters: AUROC falls from .903 globally to .857 for local-in-canvas perturbations and .735 for independently encoded crops. Frozen DINO patch tokens therefore contain a strong late-layer localization signal whose visibility depends on the perturbation and preserved context. Code: https://github.com/VishalJ99/trail-image-edit-localization.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 冻死迪诺 本地化没有本地化器的图像编辑器
articles.content_zh: 本地化的图像编辑可以改变照片的意义,同时留下大部分真实性,因此法医学分析必须识别编辑发生地点. 我们显示,来自冷冻的DINO编码器的补丁级扰动反应本身就是本地化地图. 从补丁托肯漂流(TRAIL)中实现AI-image Edits的免费本地化,应用了全球Haar扰动,并绘制了相应补丁符号之间的余弦漂移图. 在80个源码-脱联CocoGlide测试图像上,TRAIL达到903补丁AUROC对口罩监督侦探SAM的912;固定阈值Dice为619对709,而甲骨文阈值则将TRAIL提高到790. TRAIL未变换到Poisson图像插值,达到855 AUROC对864,显示该提示在没有生成器的情况下持续. 在16个DINO编码器上,最好的区块位于 .80 -.94的正常深度。 全球情况很重要:全球地方作物保护组织从903个降至857个,而独立编码作物从735个降至857个。 因此,冻结的DINO补丁符号包含一个强烈的后期本地化信号,其可见度取决于扰动和保存的上下文. 代码:https://github.com/VishalJ99/trail-image-edit-localization. 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-21.

articles.title: Institutional Books - Visual Elements: An open-source pipeline for extracting, classifying, deduplicating, and captioning visual elements from digital book collections
articles.content: Historical book collections contain rich visual elements - such as illustrations, photographs, engravings, and decorative art - that are frequently under-explored in large-scale digitization projects. While Optical Character Recognition (OCR) has standardized the extraction of textual content, these visual components offer a layer of nuance and context that remains largely untapped by automated text extraction workflows. This technical report introduces Institutional Books - Visual Elements, an open-source end-to-end pipeline for detecting, classifying, deduplicating, and captioning visual elements from historical book collections. Alongside this pipeline, we release an initial dataset of 22.6 million visual elements extracted from the 983,004 scanned volumes that comprise the Institutional Books: Harvard Library dataset. This work contributes to ongoing, community-wide efforts to enable new use cases for digitized library collections through computational access, from artificial intelligence model training to digital humanities research.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 机构书籍----视觉要素: 从数字图书收藏中提取、分类、调离和标注视觉元素的开源管道
articles.content_zh: 历史书籍收藏中包含丰富的视觉元素,如插图,照片,雕刻,装饰艺术等,这些元素在大规模数字化项目中往往没有得到充分利用. 虽然光学字符识别(OCR)已经标准化了文本内容的提取,但这些视觉组件提供了一层细微的细微度和上下文,但基本上仍未通过自动文本提取工作流程加以开发. 本技术报告介绍了机构图书——视觉要素,这是用于检测、分类、删除和描述历史图书收藏中的视觉要素的开源端到端管道。 除了这一管道外,我们发布了一套初步的数据集,其中包括从983 004个扫描卷中提取的2 260万个视觉元素,这些卷卷构成了机构图书:哈佛图书馆数据集。 这项工作有助于全社区持续开展努力,通过计算访问,从人工智能模型培训到数字人文研究,使图书馆藏书数字化的新使用案例得以使用。

articles.title: Simple, Safe, and Overlooked: Reclaiming Sustainable Domain Generalization with Statistical Color Matching
articles.content: Hardware shifts, color variations, and changing patient characteristics between development and deployment routinely break trained medical image classifiers. Existing remedies fall short: standard color jittering provides insufficient diversity, while deep generative style transfer algorithms hallucinate features, destroy clinically relevant structures, and waste massive compute resources. To address this, we revisit classical statistical color matching and repurpose it as Colorist, a highly efficient data augmentation strategy that applies global mean-standard deviation matching directly in the RGB color space. We demonstrate that this training-free, fully interpretable approach safely generates structurally intact domain variations, outperforming deep generative models in structural fidelity and color alignment. Across out-of-distribution histopathology, peripheral blood, dermatology, and retinal datasets, it improves balanced accuracy by up to +9% over state-of-the-art domain generalization regularizers and by +13% over an unaugmented baseline. Moreover, by avoiding neural networks in the augmentation loop, Colorist preserves anatomical structure, minimizes carbon footprint, and integrates seamlessly into standard dataloaders. Together, these findings establish statistical matching as a safe, interpretable, yet overlooked alternative to deep architectures for clinical robustness. Source code is available at https://github.com/sdoerrich97/colorist.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 简单,安全,和俯视: 以统计颜色匹配方式重命名可持续域
articles.content_zh: 硬件的转移,颜色的变异,以及发育与部署之间病人特点的变化,经常打破训练有素的医学影像分类器. 现有的治疗方法还很短:标准色振动提供了不充分的多样性,而深源性风格转移算法则会产生幻觉特征,破坏临床相关结构,浪费大量计算资源. 为了解决这个问题,我们重新审视古典统计色彩匹配,并重新将其作为Colorist,一种高效的数据增强策略,在RGB色彩空间直接应用全球平均标准偏差匹配. 我们证明,这种无训练、完全可解释的方法安全地产生结构完好无缺的域变,在结构忠诚度和色调一致方面,表现优于深层基因模型。 纵观分布外组织病理学、外围血液、皮肤病学和视网膜数据集,它提高了平衡准确度,比最先进的域通化常态器高达+9%,比未增强基线高+13%。 此外,通过在增强循环中避免神经网络,Colorist保留解剖结构,将碳足迹最小化,并且无缝地整合到标准的数据装载器中. 这些结论共同确立了统计匹配,认为它是一种安全、可解释、但被忽视的临床稳健性深层结构替代方案。 来源代码见https://github.com/sduerrich97/colorist.

articles.title: Learning-State-Aware Dynamic Generative Data Augmentation on Small-Scale Datasets
articles.content:
Small-scale image classification is often limited by the scarcity of training data. Generative data augmentation (GDA) based on pretrained generative models has emerged as an effective solution. However, existing methods rely on task-agnostic augmentation strategies that overlook downstream model needs. Although recent dynamic GDA methods incorporate model feedback to guide augmentation, they still struggle to reliably determine sample-specific augmentation strengths and adapt augmentation strategies to different image regions while balancing image diversity and class semantics.
  To address these issues, we propose learning-state-aware dynamic generative data augmentation (LSADA). Specifically, LSADA constructs a learning state for each sample based on its current loss and loss-decrease rate, which is then mapped to a sample-specific augmentation strength. Furthermore, LSADA introduces a decoupled data augmentation and diffusion fusion strategy that applies strength-controlled transformations to class-relevant regions and generates diverse class-irrelevant regions, progressively fusing them to improve image diversity while preserving class semantics. Experiments on nine public datasets show that LSADA outperforms the existing SOTA dynamic GDA method by an average of 4.5% on six natural image datasets and 2.5% on three medical image datasets.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 小规模数据集的学习-状态-智能动态基因数据增强
articles.content_zh:
小规模的图像分类往往受到培训数据稀缺的限制. 基于事先经过训练的基因模型的基因数据增强(GDA)已经成为一种有效的解决方案。 然而,现有方法依赖于忽略下游模型需要的任务不可知的增加战略。 虽然最近的动态GDA方法包含了模型反馈来指导增强,但它们仍然难以可靠地确定特定样本的增强优势,并根据不同的图像区域调整增强策略,同时平衡图像多样性和类语义.
为了解决这些问题,我们提议学习 -- -- 状态 -- -- 动态基因数据增强。 具体地说,LSADA根据其目前的损耗和损失减少率为每个样本构建了一个学习状态,然后将其映射为特定样本的增强强度. 此外,LSADA引入了脱钩数据增强和传播聚变战略,将强度控制的转换应用于与类有关的区域,并产生不同的与类无关的区域,逐步使这些区域产生引信,以提高图像多样性,同时保留类语义。 9个公共数据集的实验显示,LSADA在6个自然图像数据集上平均比现有的SOTA动态GDA方法高4.5%,在3个医学图像数据集上平均高出2.5%.

articles.title: Falcon Perception-HD: High Density Perception via Reinforcement Learning
articles.content: Autoregressive perception models trained to localize visual entities under the open-vocabulary setting are mostly trained using Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with maximum likelihood, yet it optimizes a proxy objective (per-token cross-entropy) that is fundamentally misaligned with perception metrics such as precision and recall. In this paper, we explore post-training reinforcement learning (RL), specifically GRPO, to directly align these models with their evaluation metrics. Building up on the recently introduced Falcon Perception, we design an RL framework that addresses perception-specific challenges: reward design for set-structured outputs and multi-head sampling control. We discover multiple benefits from RL for perception: first, RL unlocks state-of-the-art performance in very dense scenes (up to 500 objects per scene), a regime where most existing systems degrade sharply or collapse; furthermore it fixes common issues in autoregressive perception models like mask repetitions and removes almost entirely the need for NMS and coordinate deduplication, which improve both performance and efficiency and remove the need for hyperparameters tuning; overall, we notice improvements on all levels of difficulties in referring expression segmentation (on PBench and SACO-Gold), and we find an elegant way to preserve the knowledge of whether an object exists or not (as evaluated by MCC) without training on negative samples. We show that a simple reward that penalizes false negatives and positives is sufficient. We develop two hybrid self-annotation pipelines, respectively tailored for difficult referring expressions and very dense scenes, and show their benefits on RL-training. Model weights are released as a Falcon Perception revision~\footnote{https://huggingface.co/tiiuae/Falcon-Perception}. Datasets will be published.

articles.title_zh: Falcon Pension-HD:通过强化学习实现高密度感知
articles.content_zh: 受培训在开放-vobulary设置下将视觉实体本地化的自动回转感知模型大多使用有最大可能性的监管微调(SFT)进行训练,然而它却优化了一种代用目标(per-tok cross-entropy),它与精度和召回等感知度量基本错配. 在本文中,我们探索培训后强化学习(RL),特别是GRPO,以直接使这些模型与其评价衡量标准保持一致. 在最近引入的Falcon Perception的基础上,我们设计了一个RL框架,用以应对认知方面的具体挑战:设定结构输出的奖励设计和多头取样控制。 我们发现RL对感知的多重好处:第一,RL解锁了非常密集场景中最先进的性能(每个场景最多500个物体),这种制度大多数现有系统急剧降解或崩溃;此外,它还解决了自递感知模型中常见的问题,如面具重复,并几乎完全消除了NMS和协调分化的需要,这既提高了性能和效率,也消除了超参数调试的需要;总体而言,我们注意到(在PBench和SACO-Gold上)转录表达分解时遇到的各种困难有所改进,我们找到了一种优雅的方法来保存对一个物体是否存在的了解(根据MCC的评价),而不对负面样品进行培训. 我们显示,惩罚虚假负面和正面的简单奖励就足够了。 我们开发了两条混合自注管道,分别针对难以调用的表达方式和非常密集的场景进行定制,并在RL-training上显示其好处. 模型权重作为猎鹰感知修订版发布 {脚注{https://huggingface.co/tiuae/Falcon-Perception}. 数据集将公布。

articles.title: RVLoss: Runoff Vote Loss for Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow Estimation
articles.content: LiDAR scene flow estimates point-wise motion between two consecutive scans, referred to as the source and target. Leading self-supervised methods typically minimize the Chamfer loss, the nearest neighbor distance between the flow-compensated source and the target. However, nearest-neighbor search does not enforce motion rigidity, often leading to inconsistent flows within object instances. Existing approaches address this issue with additional regularization terms, but flow consistency among points remains limited, especially for large objects. We propose RVLoss, a self-supervised loss that incorporates motion rigidity by design through a runoff vote mechanism. Our key observation is that the point-wise motion, calculated from nearest neighbor search, can often be grouped into a small set of dominant flow candidates by voting (top-k voting). Furthermore, when compensating the source by these candidates, the flow that best represents the underlying rigid motion often yields the highest consensus after a second voting (top-1 voting). Based on this insight, we incorporate the two-stage runoff vote into loss design and create cluster-wise rigid flows and free-form flows as pseudo-labels for self-supervised learning. RVLoss can be seamlessly integrated into existing feedforward architectures. Experiments on the Argoverse2 2026 Challenge show that models trained with RVLoss achieve state-of-the-art performance among self-supervised approaches, outperforming baseline models trained with alternative loss designs by 20%. Moreover, cross-dataset evaluations demonstrate consistent performance improvements across four additional datasets. Code will be released upon acceptance.

articles.title_zh: RV Loss:自我监督的LiDAR的径流选票损失 场景流量估计
articles.content_zh: LiDAR场景流估计在两次连续扫描之间进行点向运动,称为源和目标. 主要的自我监督方法通常将Chamfer损失最小化,即流补偿源与目标之间的近邻距离. 然而,近邻搜索并不强制运动僵化,往往导致物体内流动不一致. 现有办法通过增加规范化术语来解决这一问题,但各点之间的流动一致性仍然有限,对于大型物体尤其如此。 我们提议RVLoss,一种自我监督的损失,通过径流投票机制通过设计纳入运动刚性. 我们的关键观察是,从最近的邻居搜索中计算出的点心运动,往往可以通过投票(top-k vote)将它组合成一小组主导流候选人. 此外,在补偿这些候选人的来源时,最能代表根本僵化动议的流动往往在第二次表决(最高一票)后产生最高共识。 基于这种洞察力,我们将两阶段的径流投票纳入损失设计中,并创建集成式刚性流和自由形式流作为自我监督学习的伪标签. RVLoss可以无缝地融入现有的feedforward架构. Argoverse2 2026挑战号上的实验显示,通过RVLoss培训的模型在自我监督的方法中实现了最先进的性能,业绩优于通过替代损失设计培训的基线模型的20%. 此外,跨数据集评价显示,另外四个数据集的业绩持续改善。 守则一经接受即公布。

articles.title: Beyond Placement and Articulation: Usage-Driven Code Scenes for Embodied Interaction
articles.content: Indoor scene synthesis provides essential environments for embodied AI, robotic manipulation, and simulation-based policy learning. Recent code-based scene generation methods produce editable and extensible environments, yet they remain focused on visual construction and object-level articulation, leaving the functional usage of scenes largely unmodeled. To address this problem, we present RoomWright, an agentic usage-driven framework for generating 3D scenes represented entirely as code for embodied interaction. RoomWright performs usage-driven object reasoning, which treats each anchor as a task centre and admits task-required objects and their affordances. A code agent further enables multi-part interaction by compiling each interaction into a trigger, condition, effect rule that updates structured object states, capturing causal dependencies across objects. Moreover, since manipuland orientation is ambiguous and hard to recover from pixels, RoomWright alleviates this via annotation-informed usage-guided orientation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. The resulting scenes are executable, editable, and simulation-ready, providing interactive environments for embodied AI and policy learning.

articles.title_zh: 除了安置和描述: 健康互动使用驱动代码
articles.content_zh: 室内场景合成为体现的AI,机器人操纵,以及模拟政策学习提供了必不可少的环境. 最近的基于代码的场景生成方法产生了可编辑和可扩展的环境,然而它们仍然专注于视觉构造和对象级别表达,使得场景的功能使用基本没有模型化. 为了解决这个问题,我们介绍RoomWright,这是一个由代理用法驱动的框架,用于生成三维场景,完全作为体现互动的代码。 RoomWright执行用法驱动的对象推理,将每个锚作为任务中心,并承认任务需要的对象及其负担. 一个代码代理通过将每个交互编译成一个触发,条件,效果规则来更新结构化对象状态,捕捉跨对象的因果关系,从而进一步实现多段交互. 此外,由于马尼普兰方向模糊不清,很难从像素中恢复,RoomWright通过注解知情的使用导向来缓解这种情况. 广泛的实验证明了我们的方法的有效性. 由此产生的场景是可执行的、可编辑的和模拟的,为体现的AI和政策学习提供了互动环境。

articles.title: EVADE: Evidence-Verified Agentic Diagnosis with Escape
articles.content: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) can achieve high accuracy but remain unreliable: they are systematically overconfident, benefit little from test-time reasoning, and lack the ability to reliably calibrate trust in their own responses. We introduce EVADE (Evidence-Verified Agentic Diagnosis with Escape), an inferential, non-training method that enhances the safety of deploying a single frozen VLM. EVADE responds and, when uncertain, localises the region most diagnostically relevant, re-answers on a zoomed view, and commits only when both the entire image and the zoomed view responses agree; otherwise, it abstains. To directly address verification hallucination in single-model self-checking, our main idea is to verify gate consistency across different image views rather than re-reading the model's own text. Experimental evaluation on VQA-RAD, SLAKE, and PathVQA using Qwen2.5-VL-7B reports that EVADE is the only method that simultaneously improves both calibration and selective risk while maintaining accuracy, reducing expected calibration error (ECE) by up to 45% compared to zero-shot. Chain-of-thought, self-consistency, and self-verification all fail at least one axis. A grounding analysis reports that self-proposed regions perform better at diagnostic structure localisation than centres or random crops. However, a 7B VLM cannot use this localisation to revise answers. Therefore, reliability gains come from the consistency gate and calibrated abstention.

articles.title_zh: EVADE: 证据 - 经证实的外逃代理诊断
articles.content_zh: 医学视觉语言模型(VLMs)可以实现高精度,但依然不可靠:它们系统化地过度自信,几乎没有从测试时间推理中受益,并且缺乏可靠校准对自身反应的信任的能力. 我们引入了EVADE(Evicence-Verified Agentic Divisions with Escape),这是一种不入微的,非训练的方法,可以增强部署单一的冷冻VLM的安全性. EVADE回应,在不确定的情况下,将该地区定位为最具有诊断意义的地区,在放大的视角上重新回答,只有在整个图像和放大的视角都同意的情况下,才作出承诺;否则,它将弃权。 为了在单模型自查中直接解决验证幻觉问题,我们的主要想法是验证不同图像观点的大门一致性,而不是重读模型自己的文本. 使用Quen2.5-VL-7B对VQA-RAD,SLAKE,PathVQA进行的实验评价报告称,EVADE是同时改进校准和选择性风险同时保持准确性的唯一方法,与零镜头相比,将预期校准误差(ECE)减少45%. 思维的链条,自我一致性,以及自我验证都至少失败了一个轴. 一项基础分析报告说,自建议区域在诊断结构定位方面比中心或随机作物更出色。 然而,一个7B VLM不能使用这种本地化来修改答案. 因此,可靠性的提高来自一致性门和经过校准的弃权。

articles.title: EfficientSync: Real-Time Lip Synchronization via Deformation-Based Reference Texture Mixing
articles.content: Audio-driven lip synchronization manipulates the mouth region of a talking-face video to match the driving audio while preserving head pose, identity, and background. Although the task is inherently local editing, prevailing approaches reconstruct the entire lower face with heavy GAN- or diffusion-based decoders, incurring substantial latency and, more critically, hallucinating intra-oral details such as teeth and lip wrinkles instead of preserving authentic textures. We contend that the bottleneck in identity preservation is not the scarcity of reference frames, but the lack of a mechanism that faithfully transfers the genuine textures they already contain. We therefore present EfficientSync, a real-time deformation-based framework that retains reference textures rather than resynthesizing them. First, the Dynamic Texture Mixer reformulates multi-reference fusion as channel-wise selection, evaluating each spatially aligned reference in a global context and aggregating them by channel-wise weighted summation, preserving textural integrity at low cost. Second, Spatio-Temporal Shifted Adaptive Masking decomposes the source frame into lip-generation conditions and an independent background prior, suppressing lower-face leakage while blending the synthesized mouth seamlessly into the background. Third, STAR Sampling, a zero-overhead pre-processing step, retrieves the sharpest and most topologically diverse reference frames. Experiments on HDTF and VFHQ show state-of-the-art visual quality and identity preservation at 166 FPS on a single GPU. Video demos: https://alunaticat.github.io/EfficientSync/index.html.

articles.title_zh: 高效 同步: 通过基于变形的参考文字混合实现实时唇形同步
articles.content_zh: 音频驱动的唇形同步操纵一个说话面视频的口区,在保持头部姿势,身份和背景的同时,匹配驱动音频. 虽然这项任务本质上是本地编辑的,但目前采用的方法是用重的GAN或扩散式解码器重建整个下面,产生相当的耐久性,更严重的是,使牙齿和唇皱等口内细节产生幻觉,而不是保存正宗的纹理. 我们争辩说,身份保护方面的瓶颈不是缺乏参考框架,而是缺乏一个忠实转移它们已经包含的真正纹理的机制。 因此,我们提出“高效合成”,即实时变形框架,保留参考纹理而不是再合成。 首先,动态纹理混合器重构多参考聚变,作为信道的任意选择,在全局范围内评价每个空间对齐的参照,并通过信道的加权总和加以汇总,以低成本保持纹理完整性. 第二,Spatio-Temporal Shiftive Masking将源帧分解为唇生成条件和独立的前背景,抑制下面渗漏,同时将合成的嘴无缝地混入背景. 第三,STAR采样是零头前处理步骤,检索最尖锐和地形多样性最强的参考框架. 在HDTF和VFHQ上的实验显示,在单一GPU上,166 FPS具有最先进的视觉质量和身份保护. 视频演示:https://alunaticat.github.io/EfficentSync/index.html.

articles.title: MIFR: A Modality-Invariant and Fair Representation Framework for Skin Disease Classification
articles.content: Skin diseases represent a major global public health burden, yet machine learning tools developed to assist in their diagnosis suffer from two critical limitations: reliance on only one modality for diagnosis and systematic performance disparities across skin tones. While existing approaches address each challenge separately, this work proposes a modality-invariant framework with fair representation (MIFR) for skin disease classification. The architecture pairs clinical photographs with dermoscopic images using ViT-based encoders, projecting each input into a high-dimensional embedding space via modality-specific projection heads. The resulting model is trained with a five-component multi-objective loss including weighted cross-entropy for classification, confusion and skin-type classification losses for fairness, per-modality supervised contrastive loss for class alignment, and a modality-invariance loss for clinical and dermoscopic modality alignment. Experiments on the HIBA+Derm7pt paired dataset and the external PAD-UFES-20 and ISIC 2019 datasets showed that modality-invariant representation learning provides competitive predictive performance compare to relevant baseline models and competitive fairness on the internal dataset. t-SNE visualizations confirmed that clinical and dermoscopic embeddings of the same disease are geometrically aligned, validating the joint objectives.

articles.title_zh: MIFR: 皮肤疾病分类模式-不变量和公平代表性框架
articles.content_zh: 皮肤疾病是全球主要公共卫生负担,但为协助诊断而开发的机器学习工具受到两个关键限制:只依靠一种诊断方式和皮肤各色调之间系统的表现差异。 虽然现有办法分别处理每项挑战,但这项工作提出了具有公平代表性的皮肤病分类模式-变量框架。 该架构将临床照片与使用基于ViT的编码器的皮肤图像配对,通过特定模式投影头将每个输入投影投影到高维嵌入空间. 由此产生的模型经过培训后,将出现五部分多重目标损失,包括加权交叉分类、混淆和皮肤类型分类损失,公平性、按模式监管的类比对比性损失,以及临床和皮肤模式调整的模式变化损失。 HIBA+Derm7pt配对数据集以及外部PAD-UFES-20和ISIC 2019数据集的实验显示,模式变化性代表学习提供了与相关基准模型相比的竞争性预测性能和内部数据集的竞争性公平性. t-SNE可视化证实,同一种疾病的临床和皮肤嵌入物几何对齐,证实了共同目标。

articles.title: SED-FOD: Scattering-Aware Expert Decomposition for Few-Shot Cross-Sensor SAR Object Detection
articles.content: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) object detection is an important part of remote sensing interpretation. However, because of variations in frequency band, resolution, background clutter, and target scattering responses, the performance of existing detectors often degrades when training and testing data are acquired from different SAR domains. Although domain adaptation methods offer a promising paradigm for solving this problem, most of them mainly pursue domain-invariant feature alignment and suppress sensor-dependent scattering characteristics that are useful for object detection. This problem becomes more challenging in few-shot scenarios, where only a few fully annotated target-domain SAR images are available. To address this issue, we propose a scattering-aware shared-specific feature decomposition framework for few-shot SAR domain adaptation object detection. We decompose detection features into a shared path and several soft-gated scattering-specific expert paths. The shared path learns transferable object structural information and is used for asymmetric domain alignment, while the scattering-specific experts adaptively compensate heterogeneous SAR responses. In addition, routing-domain auxiliary loss is introduced to encourage specific experts to capture sensor-dependent routing preferences, and an expert balancing loss is used to prevent routing collapse. Extensive experiments on four bidirectional heterogeneous SAR detection tasks between FARAD-X/FARAD-Ka and MiniSAR under different few-shot settings have been conducted and experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance in both forward and reverse adaptation directions.

articles.title_zh: SED-FOD:微波跨传感器合成孔径雷达探测器分解器
articles.content_zh: 合成孔径雷达(SAR)物体探测是遥感判读的重要组成部分. 然而,由于频带、分辨率、背景杂乱以及目标散射反应的不同,在从不同的搜索和救援领域获取培训和测试数据时,现有探测器的性能往往会下降。 虽然域调整方法为解决这一问题提供了一个很有希望的范式,但大多数方法主要追求域-不变量特征对齐,并抑制对物体检测有用的依赖传感器的散射特征. 在少数情景中,这个问题变得更加具有挑战性,因为只有几个完全附加说明的目标域搜索和救援图像。 为了解决这一问题,我们建议建立一个散射感知共享特性分解框架,用于几发合成孔径雷达域适应物体检测。 我们把探测特征分解成一条共同的路径和几条柔性散射的特定专家路径。 共享路径学习可转移的对象结构信息,用于不对称域对齐,而散射特定专家则适应性地补偿各种合成孔径雷达响应. 此外,引入了路由域辅助损失,以鼓励特定专家捕捉依赖传感器的路由偏好,并使用专家平衡损失来防止路由崩溃. 对FARAD-X/FARAD-KA和MINISAR之间在不同的几发环境中的四项双向异性合成孔径雷达探测任务进行了广泛的实验,实验结果表明,拟议方法在前向和反向适应方向都取得了优异的性能。

articles.title: Decision-Metric Alignment in Latent World Models: Diagnostics and Action-Conditioned Objectives for MPC Planning
articles.content: JEPA-style latent world models can use Euclidean distance to a goal latent as the cost for model-predictive control (MPC). Strong decoding of task variables, however, does not guarantee that this particular cost ranks candidate action sequences by real task progress. We call the latter property \emph{decision-metric alignment}. We introduce Plan-Real Spearman, which measures latent--real rank agreement on random plans, and CEM-stage Spearman, which measures the same agreement as cross-entropy-method (CEM) search concentrates its proposal. We analyze sufficient conditions under which latent distance preserves real-cost rankings, identifying encoder distortion, terminal rollout error, and candidate margins as the controlling quantities. Guided by the observed empirical alignment gap, DA-LeWM augments LeWM with inverse-dynamics and demonstration-conditioned goal-action heads. Across all our experiments, DA-LeWM accelerates convergence and achieves higher online success than LeWM, while probe scores remain similar. These results show that action-conditioned objectives improve the geometry used by Euclidean-cost, CEM-based latent MPC.

articles.title_zh: 《后期世界模式:诊断和符合行动要求的目标》 规划
articles.content_zh: JEPA式的潜在世界模型可以使用欧几利得离目标潜在距离作为模型预测控制的成本。 然而,对任务变量进行严格的解码并不能保证这一特定费用按实际任务进度排列候选人行动序列。 我们称后一个属性为\emph{ secretment- medication} 。 我们介绍的是Plan-Real Spearman,它衡量关于随机计划的潜在-实际排序协议,CEM阶段的Spearman,它测量的是与交叉-enty-medod(CEM)搜索相同的协议,它集中了它的建议. 我们分析潜在距离保持实际成本排名的充分条件,确定编码器扭曲、终端推出错误和候选边距为控制数量。 在观测到的经验调整差距的指导下,DA-LEWM增加了LEWM的反向动力学和具有示范条件的进球行动头. 在我们所有的实验中,DA-LEWM加速了趋同,实现了比LEWM更高的在线成功,同时探测分数依然相似. 这些结果表明,有行动条件的目标改进了欧几里得成本(Euclidean-cost)和CEM潜在MPC所使用的几何学.

articles.title: CL4D: Contrastive Language-4D Pretraining for Vision-Language Reasoning in Dynamic Scenes
articles.content: 4D understanding and reasoning is a fundamental capability for embodied AI agents operating in dynamic physical environments. However, existing vision encoders are largely limited to static 2D images or 3D point clouds without temporal modeling, or to 2D videos that lack accurate geometric depth reasoning. Consequently, current approaches fail to jointly capture spatial structure and motion evolution in dynamic scenes. We present CL4D, the first foundational 4D vision encoder that directly operates on dynamic point clouds, trained with a contrastive learning objective to align spatio-temporal geometric representations with natural language descriptions. By learning a shared embedding space between text and 4D scene dynamics, CL4D enables zero-shot motion-to-text and text-to-motion retrieval in dynamic environments and serves as a foundational 4D vision encoder for downstream 4D vision-language tasks. Building on this encoder, we introduce 4DVLM, a 4D vision-language model that conditions language generation on dynamic geometric representations. 4DVLM is the first VLM designed to operate directly on 4D point clouds without relying on 2D images, 2D videos, or static 3D point clouds. We train CL4D and subsequently 4DVLM on a newly constructed dataset termed DynAction4D capturing diverse human motions across varying object interactions and scene environments. Extensive experiments across multiple 4D human action benchmarks demonstrate that CL4D achieves state-of-the-art performance, with improvements of approximately ~16.75% over prior methods. Furthermore, 4DVLM outperforms frontier video VLMs such as Gemini and GPT-5 even when these models are provided with RGB video sequences corresponding to the same scenes represented as 4D point clouds for 4DVLM.

articles.title_zh: CL4D: 对比语言-4D 动态场景中的视觉-语言推理预训
articles.content_zh: 4D理解和推理是在动态物理环境中运行的内含AI剂的基本能力. 然而,现有的视觉编码器基本上仅限于静态的2D图像或3D点云,没有时间模型,或者没有精确几何深度推理的2D视频. 因此,目前的做法未能在动态场景中共同捕捉空间结构和运动演变。 我们提出CL4D,这是第一个直接在动态点云上运行的基数4D视觉编码器,训练时具有对比性的学习目标,使spatio-timor几何表示与自然语言描述一致. 通过学习文本和4D场景动态之间的共享嵌入空间,CL4D可以在动态环境中实现零镜头运动到文本和文本到运动检索,并作为下游4D视觉语言任务的基础4D视觉编码器. 基于这个编码器,我们引入了4DVLM,一种4D视觉语言模型,以动态几何表示为语言生成条件. 4DVLM是第一个VLM,设计直接运行在4D点云上,而不依赖于2D图像,2D视频,或静态3D点云. 我们训练CL4D和随后的4DVLM 在一个被称为DynAction4D的新构造数据集上,捕捉不同物体相互作用和场景环境的各种人类运动. 跨越多个4D人类行动基准的广泛实验表明,CL4D实现了最先进的性能,比以前的方法提高了约16.75%. 此外,4DVLM还超越了双子座和GPT-5等前沿视频VLM,即使这些模型得到了与4DVLM代表的4D点云相同的场景对应的RGB视频序列.

articles.title: A Few Cases Are All You Need: An Empirical Study of Annotation-Efficient LoRA Fine-Tuning of MedSAM3
articles.content: Medical image segmentation is essential for clinical workflows such as treatment planning and disease assessment. While specialist tools like TotalSegmentator and MRSegmentator achieve strong performance, they require large annotated datasets for training. Medical foundation models offer a promising alternative through large-scale pretraining that reduces the annotation burden for new tasks, but zero-shot performance remains limited. Parameter-efficient adaptation via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient specialization with few trainable parameters, but a key question remains: how many expert-annotated cases are needed to achieve clinically useful segmentation performance? We address this by adapting MedSAM3 with LoRA for five abdominal organs (liver, kidneys, spleen, gallbladder, and pancreas) in CT and MRI using only 1, 2, 5, and 10 annotated cases, evaluating on AMOS22 dataset. With just 10 cases, models achieve performance competitive with specialist systems trained on orders of magnitude more data. Notably, this includes reliable gallbladder segmentation (Dice 0.68 CT, 0.59 MRI) where existing tools fail almost completely (Dice 0.0004), while remaining within 5--10% of MRSegmentator for liver, kidneys, and spleen using over 100 times fewer annotations. Furthermore, external validation on the Whole Heart Segmentation dataset shows that the approach extends to cardiac segmentation, a use case beyond the scope of TotalSegmentator (MRI) and MRSegmentator, achieving competitive left ventricle (LV) performance with only 10 annotated cases. Training requires only3--5,hours per organ on a single GPU, approximately 2--3 times faster than nnU-Net. These findings suggest that ten annotated cases are sufficient for clinically useful segmentation, effectively reducing bottlenecks for both image annotation and training time.

articles.title_zh: 少数案例 " Are All You need: Annotation-Efficial LoRA Fine-Tuning of MeDSAM3 " 的实验性研究
articles.content_zh: 医疗图像分割对于治疗规划和疾病评估等临床工作流程至关重要. 虽然诸如TotalSecmentator和MRSecmentator等专家工具取得了强效的性能,但它们需要大型附加说明的数据集来进行培训. 医疗基础模型通过大规模预训提供了一种有希望的替代办法,减少了新任务的注解负担,但零射的性能仍然有限. 通过低Rank适应(LORA)进行参数高效的适应,能够有效专业化,但一个关键问题仍然是:需要多少个专家说明的病例才能实现临床有用的分解性能? 为此,我们仅使用1,2,5和10个注解病例,对AMOS22数据集进行评估,将MDSAM3与LORA一起用于CT和MRI的5个腹部器官(肝脏、肾脏、脾脏、胆囊和胰腺)进行改造。 由于只有10个案例,模型的性能与接受数量级更高数据培训的专家系统相竞争。 值得注意的是,这包括可靠的胆固醇分解(第0.68 CT,0.59核磁共振),即现有工具几乎完全失效(第0.0004次),而肝脏、肾脏和脾脏的分解量则保持在占MRS分解器的5%至10%以内,说明量减少100倍以上。 此外,对全心分裂数据集的外部验证表明,这种方法延伸到心脏分裂,这一使用案例超出了总分解器和MRS分解器的范围,只有10个附加说明的案例,实现了竞争性左排风(LV)性能。 在一个单一的GPU上每个器官只需要3-5小时的培训,大约比nnU-Net快2-3倍. 这些调查结果表明,有10个注解的病例足以进行临床上的有益分解,有效地减少了图像注释和培训时间的瓶颈。

articles.title: The Impact of CutMix on Reliability and Robustness in Semantic Segmentation
articles.content: Ensuring not only high accuracy but also reliable and robust predictions is critical for the deployment of semantic segmentation models in safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving. Despite the widespread use of CutMix - a simple yet powerful data augmentation strategy - its effect on the reliability and robustness in dense predictions tasks remains unexplored. Motivated by recent findings that semi-supervised segmentation methods, where CutMix is a core component, can severely degrade reliability, this study isolates and systematically analyzes the influence of CutMix on segmentation accuracy, calibration, and uncertainty quality. We evaluate two representative architectures, the CNN-based DeepLabV3+ and the transformer-based SegFormer, across both in-domain and out-of-domain scenarios. Our results show that CutMix has only a minor impact on segmentation accuracy but consistently improves the reliability, particularly under distribution shifts. These improvements indicate that CutMix primarily enhances the trustworthiness of the model's calibration and uncertainty rather than the raw segmentation prediction itself. This distinction is crucial for safety-critical deployment, where reliable confidence estimates are as important as raw performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CutMix 对语义分裂中可靠性和强性的影响
articles.content_zh: 确保不仅准确性高,而且可靠和可靠的预测,对于在自主驾驶等安全关键应用中部署语义分区模型至关重要。 尽管CutMix这一简单而强大的数据增强战略被广泛使用,但它对密集预测任务的可靠性和稳健性的影响仍然没有得到探讨。 由于最近发现CutMix为核心成分的半监督分解方法可严重降解可靠性,本研究将CutMix对分解精度,校准,不确定性质量的影响隔离并系统分析. 我们评价两个具有代表性的架构,即基于CNN的DeepLabV3+和基于变压器的SegFormer,它们跨越了域内和域外的情况。 我们的结果表明,CutMix对分解精度的影响不大,但始终提高可靠性,特别是在分配转移时。 这些改进表明CutMix主要增强模型校准和不确定性的可信度,而不是原始分解预测本身. 这种区分对于安全关键部署至关重要,因为可靠的信任估计与原始业绩同样重要。

articles.title: EgoHRV: Continuous Heart Rate Variability Estimation from Egocentric Systems for Autonomic Response and Skill Assessment
articles.content: Egocentric vision systems capture human behavior from visible cues, but overlook physiological indicators of autonomic states such as stress, engagement, and attention. Heart rate variability (HRV) is a widely used noninvasive marker of autonomic regulation under stress. HRV reflects small timing differences between successive heartbeats and has so far been out of reach for egocentric platforms, where motion and noise in gaze video mask exactly this fine-grained timing. We propose EgoHRV, a method that estimates HRV as well as heart rate (HR) from the gaze cameras that are already integrated into egocentric headsets. Our pipeline combines a 3D backbone with a novel low--high decomposition module that extracts the blood volume pulse (BVP) signal from gaze video. Our cross-domain pretraining aligns the frequency-domain representations of contact-based and camera-derived signals. This alignment gives EgoHRV the temporal precision to recover HRV from the subtle fluctuations in gaze video. EgoHRV achieves state-of-the-art accuracy for HR and HRV estimation from egocentric video, and its uncertainty-aware design improves downstream behavioral modeling. Integrating our HRV estimates and confidence measures into EgoExo4D's proficiency estimator raises accuracy by 17.8%. Beyond skill, continuous HRV estimation also opens egocentric systems to stress- and arousal-aware estimation tasks. Code: https://github.com/eth-siplab/EgoHRV
