articles.title_zh: EgoHRV:从Egocentral Systems获得的关于自动反应和技能评估的连续心率可变性估计
articles.content_zh: 爱果中心视觉系统从可见的提示中捕捉人类行为,但忽略了自体状态的生理指标,如压力,接触和注意力. 心率变异(HRV)是压力下广泛使用的非侵入性自体调节标记. HRV反映了连续心跳之间的小时间差异,到目前为止,对于以自我为中心的平台来说,一直无法达到,在视线中的动作和噪音恰恰掩盖了这种精细的计时. 我们提出EgoHRV, 这种方法估计HRV以及心率(HR), 我们的管道结合了3D骨干和一个新颖的低高分解模块,从央视视频中提取出血量脉冲(BVP)信号. 我们的跨域预训协调了基于接触和相机信号的频率域表示. 这种对齐使得EgoHRV具有时间精度,可以从视觉视频的微妙波动中恢复HRV. EgoHRV通过以自我为中心的视频实现HR和HRV估算的最先进准确性,它的不确定性意识设计改进了下游的行为模式. 将我们的HRV估计和信心措施纳入EgoExo4D的熟练程度估计器,精确度提高了17.8%. 除了技能外,连续的HRV估计也开启了以自我为中心的系统来承担压力和唤醒意识的估计任务. 代码:https://github.com/eth-siplab/EgoHRV 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-21.

articles.title: CamWorldQA: Perceptual Quality Assessment of Camera-Controlled World Video Generation
articles.content: Recent advances in generative video models have enabled camera-controlled world video generation, allowing models to synthesize videos under user-defined camera trajectories. However, existing video quality assessment (VQA) methods are mainly developed for natural videos and fail to capture the unique perceptual characteristics of camera-controlled generation, such as viewpoint consistency, motion coherence, and content preservation. In this work, we introduce CamWorldQA, the first benchmark for perceptual quality assessment of camera-controlled world video generation. CamWorldQA contains 720 generated videos produced by 6 representative generation methods from 20 diverse source videos under 6 camera trajectories, where each video is annotated with a human-rated perceptual quality score through subjective experiments. Furthermore, we propose CWQA, a no-reference quality assessment network with three complementary branches that extract spatial features, temporal motion features and optical flow features to jointly predict quality scores. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CWQA achieves superior performance over existing quality assessment methods on the CamWorldQA dataset.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CamWorldQA:摄像头控制的世界视频生成概念质量评估
articles.content_zh: 基因视频模型的近期进步使得相机控制的世界视频生成得以进行,使得模型可以在用户定义的相机轨迹下合成视频. 然而,现有的视频质量评估(VQA)方法主要是针对自然视频开发的,未能捕捉到相机控制生成的独特感知特征,如视角一致性,运动一致性,以及内容保存. 在这部作品中,我们引入了CamWorldQA,这是对相机控制的世界视频生成进行感知质量评估的第一个基准. 凸轮世界 QA包含由6个代表性生成方法从6个相机轨迹下的20个不同源视频中生成的720个视频,其中每个视频通过主观实验附加了人评分的感知质量分数. 此外,我们提议建立无参考质量评估网络CWQA,由三个互补分支组成,提取空间特征、时间运动特征和光学流动特征,共同预测质量分数。 广泛的实验表明,CWQA在CamWorldQA数据集上取得了优于现有质量评估方法的性能.

articles.title: A Critical Synthesis of Uncertainty Quantification and Foundation Models for Semantic Segmentation
articles.content: Foundation models are increasingly breaking what seemed to be impossible not long ago by enabling unprecedented accuracy and cross-domain generalization. Yet their lack of interpretability, tendency to be overconfident, and sensitivity to real-world domain shifts pose critical challenges for safety- and mission-critical applications. Uncertainty quantification (UQ) offers a principled way to address these issues, but its integration into segmentation foundation models has yet to be explored. In this paper we present the first systematic evaluation of UQ methods applied to a foundation model for semantic segmentation. We fine-tune a lightweight DPT decoder on top of the pretrained SAM2 encoder to establish a simple yet competitive baseline and benchmark four representative UQ approaches - Monte Carlo Dropout, Deep Sub-Ensemble, Test-Time Augmentation, and Evidential Deep Learning - across Cityscapes, NYUv2, and two challenging out-of-domain settings. Our analysis compares segmentation accuracy, calibration, uncertainty quality, and inference time, revealing clear trade-offs between predictive performance, reliability, and computational cost. These results highlight both the promise and the current limitations of uncertainty-aware foundation models, pointing to the need for future work that jointly optimizes accuracy, robustness, and efficiency for real-world deployment.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 不确定性量化和语义分裂基础模型的关键综合
articles.content_zh: 基础模型越来越打破了不久前似乎不可能实现的目标,能够实现前所未有的准确性和跨域通用。 然而,它们缺乏可解释性、过于自信和对现实世界领域变化的敏感性,对安全和任务至关重要的应用提出了严峻挑战。 不确定性的量化为解决这些问题提供了一个原则性的方法,但是尚未探讨将其纳入分化基础模型的问题。 在本文中,我们介绍了对用于语义分解基础模型的UQ方法的第一次系统评估。 我们微调一个轻量级的 DPT 解码器 在预先训练的 SAM2 编码器之上 建立一个简单但有竞争力的基线和基准 四个具有代表性的 UQ 方法 - 蒙特卡洛 Droppout, Deep Sub-Ensemble, Test-Time Upment, 和 Evidicious Deep Learning - 跨越城市景观, NYUv2, 以及两个具有挑战性的域外设置. 我们的分析比较了分解精度、校准、不确定性质量和推断时间,揭示了预测性能、可靠性和计算成本之间的明确权衡。 这些成果突出了认识不确定性的基础模型的前景和目前的局限性,指出今后需要共同优化准确性、稳健性和效率的工作,以便实际部署。

articles.title: Impact of Iterative Fine-Tuning on Transcription Accuracy in Complex Historical Sanskrit Manuscripts
articles.content: Digitizing the text from handwritten historical manuscripts is required to make them easily accessible, preservable, and to enable historical scholars to study them in new ways. Historical manuscripts, however, often exhibit complex heterogeneous layouts and non-standard appearance due to period-specific writing styles, page textures, camera noise, and other nuisance factors, making them difficult to perform OCR on. To tackle this challenge, we introduce a local traditional OCR pipeline, which can be iteratively fine-tuned on the target manuscript at the layout-level and the appearance-level. By adapting to the target manuscript distribution, the proposed Traditional OCR pipeline makes better predictions on subsequent pages, causing iterative reduction in human annotation effort, which is expensive and time-consuming as it requires historical domain expertise. Using this pipeline, we digitize text from three complex historical Sanskrit manuscripts and introduce a dataset with granular layout-level annotations, along with Unicode annotations in the standard PAGE-XML format. We demonstrate quantitative gains due to iterative fine-tuning of the proposed traditional OCR pipeline, and also benchmark the performance of leading Multi-Modal Large Language Models on the introduced Dataset. Code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/flame-cai/gnn-synthetic-layout-historical/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 迭代精细图解对复杂历史梵语手稿中译名准确性的影响
articles.content_zh: 需要从手写历史手稿中将文字数字化,使其易于获取,可保护,并使历史学者能够以新的方式研究. 然而,历史手稿往往表现出复杂多样的布局和不标准的外观,这是由于时期特定的写作风格,页面纹理,相机噪声,以及其他的烦扰因素,使得它们难以执行OCR. 为了应对这一挑战,我们引入了当地传统的OCR管道,可以在布局和外观层面对目标手稿进行迭代微调. 通过适应目标手稿的分发,拟议的传统OCR管道在之后的几页上做了更好的预测,导致人的注解努力的迭代减少,由于需要历史领域的专门知识,这既昂贵又耗时. 利用这个管道,我们从三个复杂的历史梵文手稿中将文本数字化,并引入一个带有颗粒式布局级别说明的数据集,同时采用标准PAGE-XML格式的Unicode说明. 由于对拟议的传统OCR管道进行迭代微调,我们展示了数量上的收益,并在引入的数据集上将领先的多模式大语言模型的性能作为基准。 代码和数据集见:https://github.com/flame-cai/gnn-synthetic-layout-historical/.

articles.title: Composed Historical Image Retrieval by Modeling Temporal Representations
articles.content: While time evolves linearly, the geometry of neural embedding spaces is inherently multi-dimensional, often chaotic, and difficult to interpret. In principle, one could constrain an embedding space to a single temporal dimension; however, such a reduction would sacrifice performance on downstream tasks, as one-dimensional embeddings cannot retain sufficient expressive capacity. This paper asks whether it is possible to learn representations that preserve temporal structure while remaining effective for image and object retrieval, and answers this question by building the mathematical foundations of such a system. We propose Temporally Decomposable Image Representations (TDIR), a representation learning algorithm that decomposes historical photographs into separate date and content components through orthogonal subspaces. We define and prove the conditions under which such a decomposition is achievable, characterize the error incurred when those conditions are only partially met, and show that orthogonality between temporal and categorical subspaces emerges naturally from the joint optimization, without requiring it to be imposed explicitly. Beyond its geometric properties, TDIR enables a class of transitive operations on embedding spaces: the temporal information of one image can be extracted and injected into the representation of another, with no label supervision required. All theoretical properties are grounded and validated in the real-world problem of Composed Image Retrieval on historical photographs, where a query simultaneously specifies object content and a target time period, either through labels or through example images. This in-the-wild setting serves as a concrete backing for the propositions we derive, offering an intuitive and interpretable way to navigate photographic archives while maintaining competitive performance in both date estimation and object retrieval.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 由历史组成 以模拟时间表示方式获取图像
articles.content_zh: 时间虽然呈线性演化,但神经嵌入空间的几何是内在的多维,往往混乱,难以解释. 原则上,可以将嵌入空间限制在单一的时间范围内;然而,这种缩小会牺牲下游任务的业绩,因为单维嵌入不能保留足够的表达能力。 本文询问是否可以学习保留时间结构同时保持有效图像和对象检索的表示法,并通过建立这种系统的数学基础来回答这个问题. 我们提出临时可分解图像表达(TDIR),一种通过正统子空间将历史照片分解成独立的日期和内容组件的表达学习算法. 我们界定和证明这种分解可以实现的条件,描述这些条件只得到部分满足时发生的错误,并表明时间空间和绝对子空间之间的正统性从联合优化中自然产生,而不需要明确强加。 除了其几何特性外,TDIR还能在嵌入空间上进行一类过渡性操作:一个图像的时间信息可以提取并注入另一个图像的表示,不需要标签监督. 所有理论属性都基于历史照片上的混凝土图像检索现实世界问题,通过标签或实例图像,查询同时指定对象内容和目标时间段. 这种万事俱备的设定为我们得出的主张提供了具体支持,为导航摄影档案提供了直观和可解释的方式,同时在估计日期和检索对象方面保持竞争性的表现。

articles.title: DocClaw: A Unified Agentic System for Intelligent Document Processing
articles.content: Intelligent document processing (IDP) encompasses a broad range of tasks, including optical character recognition (OCR), document question answering (DocQA), and key information extraction (KIE). Despite their distinct objectives, these tasks share a common need to perceive document content, acquire task-relevant information, and progressively refine intermediate results. However, they are typically formulated as separate prediction problems and addressed by task-specific models or processing pipelines. We introduce DocClaw, a unified agentic system that formulates diverse intelligent document processing tasks as a shared process of interaction between an agent and a document. Given a document and a task-specific query, DocClaw follows an appropriate document skill to iteratively identify the information required, invoke relevant tools, and integrate the resulting observations into the desired output. Throughout this process, a structured document state organizes reusable document knowledge and task-specific interaction context, allowing the agent to accumulate, revisit, and progressively refine information as the interaction proceeds. Under this formulation, task-specific requirements are captured by the agent's interpretation of the query objective and the corresponding document skill, while the underlying interaction loop, tool space, and document state are shared across tasks. Extensive experiments across multiple intelligent document processing benchmarks demonstrate that DocClaw effectively handles diverse tasks within a single agentic framework and achieves competitive performance compared with both general-purpose VLMs and task-specific methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DocClaw:智能文件处理统一代理系统
articles.content_zh: 智能文档处理(IDP)包含广泛的任务,包括光学字符识别(OCR),文档问答(DocQA),以及关键信息提取(KIE). 尽管这些任务有其不同的目标,但共同需要了解文件内容,获得与任务有关的信息,并逐步改进中间成果。 然而,它们通常被编为单独的预测问题,并通过特定任务的模型或加工管道来解决。 我们引入了DocClaw,一个统一的代理系统,它将各种智能文件处理任务制定成一个代理与文件之间互动的共享过程. 鉴于文件和特定任务的查询,DocClaw遵循适当的文档技能,迭代识别所需信息,援引相关工具,并将由此产生的观测结果纳入预期产出。 在整个过程中,结构化的文档状态组织可重复使用的文档知识和针对特定任务的交互环境,使代理人能够随着交互过程的展开而积累,重新审视并逐步完善信息. 在这种提法下,任务特定要求通过代理对查询目的和相应文档技能的解释来捕捉,而基础交互循环,工具空间,文档状态则在任务之间共享. 跨越多种智能文件处理基准的广泛实验表明,DocClaw在单一代理框架内有效处理各种任务,与通用的VLM和任务特定方法相比,实现竞争性性能.

articles.title: FRAGMENT: Factorized Graph Representations for Document Generation and Editing via Entity-Aware Transformations
articles.content: Structured documents such as invoices, forms, reports, and scientific articles derive meaning from the interplay between spatial layout, textual content, and logical structure. Generative models operating at the pixel or token level often struggle to capture these dependencies effectively. We explore FRAGMENT, a generative framework that represents a document as a typed relational graph and factorizes its distribution as p(structure, content) = p(structure) * p(content | structure). The framework consists of two stages. The first stage, the Architect, is a causally masked Transformer conditioned on document category that autoregressively generates the graph topology and typed spatial relations. The second stage, the Builder, is a GATv2-based graph attention network that enriches the graph with normalized bounding boxes, text, and visual style attributes. Both stages define explicit likelihood models, yielding a tractable document-level likelihood that serves as an anomaly score for forgery detection. For controlled editing, a prompt-conditioned extension injects instruction embeddings into the Builder through cross-attention, enabling semantic and entity-aware modifications. We describe training on DocLayNet and fine-tuning on FUNSD and SROIE. Experiments on DocLayNet, FUNSD, and SROIE evaluate FRAGMENT alongside representative autoregressive, layout-only, and graph-based baselines, providing an empirical analysis of the characteristics and trade-offs of the proposed factorized graph generation framework.

articles.title_zh: FRAGMENT:通过实体-软件转换生成和编辑文件的参数化图表
articles.content_zh: 发票、表格、报告和科学文章等结构化文件从空间布局、文字内容和逻辑结构之间的相互作用中产生意义。 在像素或符号级别上运行的基因模型往往会为有效捕捉这些依赖性而挣扎. 我们探索FRAGMENT(FRAGMENT),这是一个代表文档作为打字关系图的基因框架,并将它的分布作为p(结构,内容)=p(结构) *(内容)=Q(结构)的因素化. 该框架包括两个阶段。 第一阶段"建筑师"(英語:The Architecture)是一款以文档类别为条件的因果蒙蔽变形器,自动生成图形地形和打字空间关系. 第二阶段"构建者"(Builder)是一个基于GATv2的图注网络,它以规范的边框,文字,和视觉风格属性丰富图文. 两个阶段都定义了明确的可能性模型,产生了可操作的文档级别的可能性,作为伪造检测的异常分数. 对于有控制的编辑,一个快速的有条件的扩展通过交叉意念向构建器注入嵌入指令,使语义和实体意识的修改成为可能. 我们描述了DocLayNet的培训以及FUNSD和SROIE的微调。 在DocLayNet、FUNSD和SROIE的实验中,除了具有代表性的自动递减、排版和基于图表的基线外,还评估了FRAGMENT, 提供了对拟议要素化图表生成框架的特点和取舍的实证分析。

articles.title: DynCur-Geo: Dynamic Curiosity Reward Shaping for Multimodal Active Geo-Localization
articles.content: Active geo-localization enables low-altitude UAVs to search for specified targets from limited local aerial observations, supporting time-sensitive applications such as search and rescue and emergency inspection. However, multimodal target cues, restricted views, and sparse feedback make it difficult to balance exploration with target convergence. Existing curiosity-driven methods assign a fixed intrinsic-reward weight throughout search, which can continue rewarding novelty after the agent nears the target and induce detours. We propose DynCur-Geo, a dynamic curiosity framework that adjusts prediction-error intrinsic reward according to remaining target distance. A distance-aware gate encourages early exploration and shifts the policy toward goal-directed behavior near the target, while potential-based reward shaping supplies dense progress guidance. Experiments across multimodal, cross-scene, disaster-affected, and long-range settings show consistent gains over active geo-localization baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DynCur-Geo: 动态好奇心奖励多模式活动地理本地化
articles.content_zh: 积极的地理定位使低空无人驾驶飞行器能够从有限的当地空中观测中搜索到指定的目标,支持搜索和救援以及紧急检查等具有时间敏感性的应用. 然而,由于多式联运目标提示、有限观点和少量反馈,很难在探索与目标趋同之间取得平衡。 现有的好奇驱动方法在整个搜索过程中分配了固定的内在回报权重,在代理者接近目标并诱导绕行后,这可以继续奖励新颖性. 我们提出DynCur-Geo,这是一个动态的好奇心框架,它根据剩下的目标距离来调整预测-错误的内在回报. 远视门鼓励及早探索,并将政策转向目标附近的目标导向行为,而基于潜在奖励的塑造则提供密集的进步指导。 跨多模式、跨地、受灾害影响和长距离环境的实验显示,相对于活跃的地缘定位基线而言,不断提高。

articles.title: Vision-Language Models for Egocentric Video: From Hand-Object Interaction to Embodied AI
articles.content: Egocentric video captures activities from the wearer's perspective, providing a direct view of human attention, hand--object interaction, and goal-directed behavior. This perspective is increasingly important for wearable intelligence, assistive systems, human--robot interaction, and embodied AI, yet it introduces challenges including ego-motion, occlusion, small active objects, viewpoint-dependent appearance, and long-range temporal dependencies. Vision--language models (VLMs) offer a promising foundation for addressing these challenges by linking visual observations with semantic knowledge and natural-language supervision. This survey presents a critical review of VLMs for egocentric video understanding, tracing the progression from conventional recognition architectures to multimodal foundation models and embodied systems. We organize the literature around tasks, datasets, hand--object interaction understanding, temporal reasoning, frame and clip selection, multimodal representation learning, prompting, semantic alignment, and model adaptation. Particular attention is given to graph-based and object-centric reasoning as mechanisms for modeling relations among hands, objects, actions, and scene context over time. We further examine how first-person perception and multimodal foundation models support wearable assistance, robot skill learning, human-to-robot transfer, and embodied decision making. Across the reviewed literature, a consistent limitation emerges: current models recognize visible objects more reliably than evolving interactions, actions, and user intent, especially over long activities. We therefore identify temporally grounded reasoning, interaction-aware supervision, efficient long-video processing, multimodal fusion, graph-enhanced representations, cross-domain generalization, privacy, and trustworthy evaluation as key priorities for deployable embodied intelligence.

articles.title_zh: Egocentral的愿景语言模型 视频:从手-对象互动到健美AI
articles.content_zh: 爱果中心视频从穿戴者的角度来捕捉活动,提供人类关注的直接视角,手-物交互,以及目标定向的行为. 这种观点对于可穿戴的智能,辅助系统,人与机器人的相互作用,以及体现AI越来越重要,然而它带来了挑战,包括自我运动,隔离,小型活动对象,视线依赖外观,以及长距离的时间依赖. 视觉-语言模型通过将视觉观测与语义知识和自然语言监督联系起来,为应对这些挑战提供了一个有希望的基础。 这项调查对以自我为中心的视频理解的甚高频进行了批判性审查,追踪了从传统识别架构到多式联运基础模型和所体现系统的进展。 我们围绕任务、数据集、手物交互理解、时间推理、框架和剪辑选择、多式联运表现学习、催化、语义调整和模型调整来组织文献。 特别注意以图表为基础和以对象为中心的推理,以此作为长期模拟手、物体、行动和场景背景之间关系的机制。 我们进一步审查第一人称感知和多式联运基础模型如何支持可穿戴的援助、机器人技能学习、人对机器人的转让以及体现决策。 在所审查的文献中,出现了一致的限制:目前的模型比演变中的相互作用、行动和用户意图更可靠地识别可见物体,特别是在长期活动中。 因此,我们将基于时间的推理、互动意识监督、高效的长视频处理、多式联运、图表强化表述、跨领域概括、隐私和可信赖的评价确定为可部署的包含情报的关键优先事项。

articles.title: Teeth2Point: A Two-Stage Dental CBCT ROI-to-Point Segmentation Framework
articles.content: Modern deep learning architectures have demonstrated strong performance in dental CBCT segmentation. One remaining crucial challenge is accurate tooth labeling in cases with missing or malpositioned teeth, which are highly relevant for dental practice. Transformer-based architectures should in theory be able to resolve such ambiguities using global anatomical context. However, due to the high resolution of CBCT volumes and the wide spatial distribution of teeth within volumes, dense patch-based volumetric processing faces an inherent trade-off. Computational costs limit the number of patches that can be used in self-attention and thus, one can either increase the extent of the context captured in self-attention or capture fine-grained structural details by using small patches, but not both. In this work, we present Teeth2Point, an efficient point-based transformer framework for dental CBCT semantic segmentation that can avoid this trade-off. Teeth2Point first localizes volumetric regions of interest (ROIs) surrounding teeth using a convolutional model, then converts ROIs into point tokens using adaptive sampling. A transformer model predicts accurate segmentations using the point tokens, which allow capturing global context while retaining high resolution. The transformer is first pretrained using self-supervised learning (SSL), in the style of DINO but using domain-specific augmentation strategies, followed by supervised finetuning. The SSL pretraining, which includes random token masking, provides robustness to complex anatomical variations. Compared with the strongest two-stage baseline, Teeth2Point improves abnormal-case performance by 1.44 DSC points on average across four datasets; relative to the first-stage nnU-Net, the gain is 1.9 points.

articles.title_zh: 牙齿2点:双层牙科CBCT ROI对点分片框架
articles.content_zh: 现代深层学习建筑在牙科CBCT分化中表现出了强大的性能. 还有一个关键的挑战,是在牙齿缺失或出现畸形的情况下贴上准确的牙齿标签,这与牙科手术密切相关。 基于变形器的架构在理论上应能利用全球解剖学背景来解决这种模糊之处。 然而,由于CBCT卷的分辨率很高,牙齿在卷内空间分布很广,密集的基于补丁的卷理处理面临着内在的权衡. 计算成本限制可以用于自觉的补丁数量,因此,可以增加自觉所捕捉的上下文范围,也可以通过使用小补丁捕捉精细的结构细节,但两者不能同时使用. 在这项工作中,我们介绍了Teeth2Point,这是一个有效的基于点变压器框架,用于牙科CBCT语义分解,可以避免这种权衡. 齿质2Point首先使用一个演化模型将周围感兴趣的体积区域(ROIs)本地化,然后利用适应性取样将ROIs转换成点符号. 一个变压器模型利用点符号预测准确的分解,这可以捕捉全球背景,同时保留高分辨率. 变压器首先采用自控学习(SSL)进行预训,采用DINO的风格,但采用特定域的增强策略,之后进行有监督的微调. SSL预训包括随机代号掩码,为复杂的解剖变异提供坚固性. 与最强的两阶段基线相比,Teeth2Point在四个数据集中平均改善1.44 DSC的异常情况性能;相对于第一阶段的nU-Net,增益为1.9分.

articles.title: Dynamic SpectraFormer for Ultra-High-Definition Underwater Image Enhancement
articles.content: Underwater images suffer from color distortion, haze, and poor visibility due to light refraction and absorption in water. These challenges significantly impact the utilization of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) or marine robots. Typically, color and brightness distortions manifest at lower frequencies, while edge and texture distortions are prevalent at higher frequencies. Traditional methods struggle to concurrently rectify these mixed distortions as they primarily concentrate on the spatial domain. To address these issues, we introduce the Dynamic SpectraFormer, which enhances underwater images through a frequency domain transformer. The Dynamic SpectraFormer introduces an ultra-high-resolution sparse spectrum attention module, which could capture the long-term dependency without losing the universal approximating power. Additionally, we have developed a dynamic spectrum weight generation layer that serves as an adaptive spectrum band selector, accentuating critical frequency bands and suppressing less relevant ones. Consequently, this method significantly improves underwater image quality by addressing both high- and low-frequency distortions. Our extensive ablation studies and comparative evaluations consolidate the Dynamic SpectraFormer's efficacy across multiple underwater image enhancement benchmarks. The source code is available at https://github.com/arifence2024/DynamicSpectraFormer.git.

articles.title_zh: 超高定义水下图像增强的动态光谱前置器
articles.content_zh: 水下图像因光折射和水中吸收而出现色调扭曲,雾霾,可见度差. 这些挑战严重影响了水下自主车辆(AUV)或海洋机器人的利用。 典型的情况是,颜色和亮度的扭曲表现在频率较低,而边缘和纹理的扭曲表现在频率较高时很普遍。 传统方法试图同时纠正这些混合扭曲,因为它们主要集中于空间领域。 为了解决这些问题,我们引入了动态光谱Former,通过频率域变压器增强水下图像. Dynamic SpectraFormer引入了一个超高分辨率的稀疏频谱关注模块,它可以捕捉长期依赖性而不失去普遍近似力. 此外,我们开发了动态频谱重量生成层,作为适应性频谱带选择器,突出临界频带并压制不太相关的频带。 因此,这种方法通过处理高频和低频扭曲,大大提高了水下图像质量。 我们广泛的消融研究和比较评价巩固了动态光谱在多个水下图像增强基准上的功效。 源代码见https://github.com/arifence2024/DynamicSpectraFormer.git.

articles.title: Clinically Structured Surrogate Rewards for Post-SFT Medical Image Captioning
articles.content: Medical image captioning requires translating heterogeneous visual evidence into concise clinical descriptions, where errors in findings, assertion states, or anatomical relations can alter clinical meaning despite surface-level fluency. Sequence-level policy optimization can directly optimize complete captions, but common rewards rely on global text similarity, direct image-caption compatibility, or unordered concept overlap, leaving visual neighborhoods and clinical-claim structure implicit. We propose a clinically structured surrogate reward framework for post-SFT medical image captioning. The framework combines biomedical semantic and short-range lexical fidelity with two structured rewards: distributional image-neighborhood alignment, which matches the medical-image-bank distributions induced by reference and generated captions, and clinical graph consistency, which applies maximum-weight one-to-one matching to entities, assertion states, and typed relations. The four rewards are independently normalized within each rollout group, combined with fixed relative weights, and optimized with GDPO. Across organizer-evaluated hidden test sets for the Standard and Synthetical ImageCLEFmedical Caption tracks and three vision-language backbones, the method improves Overall, Relevance, and Factuality over matched SFT baselines in all six backbone-track combinations, with average relative gains of 3.4%, 2.1%, and 5.8%, respectively. Ablations and paired diagnostics indicate that the structured rewards provide complementary signals, reducing image-neighborhood divergence and improving entity-assertion-relation consistency.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SFT后临床结构化代理奖 医疗图像说明
articles.content_zh: 医学图像字幕要求将各种视觉证据转化为简明的临床描述,其中发现、断言或解剖关系的误差可以改变临床意义,尽管表面水平流畅。 序列级政策优化可以直接优化完整的标题,但常见的奖励依赖于全局文本的相似性,直接的图像封装兼容性,或无序的概念重叠,使得视觉邻里和临床诉求结构隐含. 我们提出一个临床结构化的替代奖赏框架,用于SFT后的医疗图像字幕. 该框架将生物医学语义学和短程词学忠义学与两个结构化的奖赏结合起来:分布式图像-邻里对齐,与参考和生成的字幕引发的医学-图像-银行分布相匹配;临床图一致性,将最大重量的一对一匹配应用于实体,断言状态,以及打字关系. 四个奖项在每个推出组内独立正常化,结合固定相对权重,并与GDPO进行优化. 在标准与合成图像CLEF医学说明轨迹和三个视觉语言主干线的全组织者评估的隐藏测试集中,该方法提高了总体性、相关性和真实性,超过了所有六个主干道组合的SFT基线,平均相对收益分别为3.4%、2.1%和5.8%。 错位和配对诊断表明,结构化的奖励提供了互补信号,减少了图像-邻里差异,改善了实体-承接-关系的一致性.

articles.title: SAM2Dual: Training-Free, Dual Memory for Long-Term Video Object Segmentation
articles.content: Long-term video object segmentation (VOS) remains challenging due to error accumulation under extended occlusions, re-appearance, and scene changes. Although SAM2 provides strong zero-shot performance, its streaming memory can amplify drift over long horizons when recent, unreliable predictions dominate the memory state. We propose SAM2Dual, a training-free, plug-and-play inference-time enhancement that improves long-video robustness without updating model weights. SAM2Dual introduces a Dual Memory design that explicitly separates (i) short-term memory for rapid local adaptation and (ii) long-term memory built via interval-based sampling to preserve global identity cues, combined through a gated fusion strategy. In addition, we present Text-Aware Memory (TAM), which extracts a compact word-level cue from early frames and uses text embeddings to reweight memory contributions based on semantic compatibility, supporting identity preservation when visual evidence becomes weak or ambiguous. Across long-term benchmarks, SAM2Dual consistently improves stability on long videos, raising J&F from 49.33 to 50.65 on MOSEv2 and achieving consistent gains on LVOSv2.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SAM2Dual:长期视频对象分区的无培训双记忆
articles.content_zh: 长期视频物体分解(VOS)仍然具有挑战性,原因是在扩展隔离、重新出现和场景变化下出现错误。 尽管SAM2提供了强烈的零射性能,但是当最近不可靠的预测占据了内存状态时,其流传的内存可以扩大漂移到长的视野. 我们提出SAM2Dual,一种没有训练,插座和游戏推断时间的增强,在不更新模型权重的情况下提高长视频的稳健性. SAM2Dual引入了双重内存设计,明确区分(一)快速局部适应的短期内存和(二)通过间隔取样建立的长期内存,以保存全球身份提示,通过闸门聚变策略结合. 此外,我们呈现的是文本-智能内存(TAM),它从早期的帧中提取一个紧凑的词级提示,并使用文本嵌入来根据语义兼容性重新对内存贡献进行加权,在视觉证据变得弱或模糊时支持身份保存. 从长期基准来看,SAM2Dual持续改善长视频的稳定性,将MOSEv2上的J&F从49.33提高到50.65,并在LVOSv2上取得一致收益.

articles.title: When Safety Overrides Vision: Exploring Dynamics between Vision Influence and Safety Alignment in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Aligned vision-language models (VLMs) are designed to balance grounded visual reasoning with safe generation behavior. However, we observe a striking phenomenon: under safety-constrained instruction, models frequently abstain from answering questions that remain correctly answerable under default instruction despite receiving identical image-question inputs. This raises a fundamental question: does safety alignment suppress perceptual grounding itself, or does visual evidence remain internally available while generation is redirected toward abstention? In this work, we investigate the internal decoding dynamics underlying safety-induced abstention in aligned VLMs. Across multiple architectures and multimodal benchmarks, we show that abstained generations remain consistently influenced by visual evidence throughout decoding, indicating that perceptual grounding is largely preserved despite refusal behavior. We further demonstrate that, although the representational organization of refusal differs substantially across architectures, safety-constrained instruction consistently alters late-stage hidden-state dynamics toward refusal-oriented decoding. Finally, through targeted activation-level interventions, we show that suppressing refusal-related representations reliably restores grounded answering behavior across models without retraining or modifying visual inputs. Together, these findings reveal a previously underexplored failure mode in aligned VLMs: safety alignment can override grounded visual expression even when perceptual evidence remains internally preserved.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当安全覆盖愿景:探索愿景影响与愿景-语言模型安全一致性之间的动态
articles.content_zh: 相联视觉语言模型(VLMs)旨在平衡立足的视觉推理和安全生成行为. 然而,我们观察到一个引人注目的现象:在安全限制的指令下,模型往往不回答在默认指令下仍然可以正确回答的问题,尽管接收到相同的图像问题输入。 这提出了一个根本性的问题:安全协调是否抑制了感知性地扎地,或者,在一代人转向弃权时,视觉证据是否仍在内部提供? 在这项工作中,我们调查了安全导致的对等VLM弃权的内部编码动态。 在多种建筑和多式联运基准中,我们显示,弃权的几代人在整个解码过程中始终受到视觉证据的影响,这表明,尽管有拒绝行为,但概念地基基本上得到了保留。 我们进一步表明,虽然不同结构的拒绝代表组织差别很大,但安全限制的指令始终改变晚期隐藏状态的动态,转向以拒绝为导向的解码。 最后,我们通过定向激活层面的干预,表明压制与拒绝相关的表述可靠地恢复了不同模式的有根据的回答行为,而无需再培训或修改视觉投入。 这些结论共同揭示了先前在对齐的VLM中未充分探索的故障模式:即使知觉证据仍然在内部保存,安全对齐仍可以凌驾于基于视觉的表达.

articles.title: PCQA-R1: Advancing Generalized 3D Point Cloud Quality Assessment with Reinforcement Learning
articles.content: No-reference point cloud quality assessment (PCQA) has been an active topic in recent years and is used to measure and optimize the visual experience of point clouds. However, large multimodal models (LMMs) have rarely been explored in this area. Previous LMM-based methods mainly rely on supervised fine-tuning to directly predict numerical quality scores, lacking the ability to generalize across datasets with heterogeneous MOS scales and limited annotations. A key difficulty is that absolute MOS regression can be brittle across datasets with different score scales and distortion distributions, whereas relative quality ranking is more stable under such shifts. In this paper, we present PCQA-R1, the first reinforcement learning LMM for 3D point cloud quality assessment to simultaneously model quality understanding and scoring. Built upon the group relative policy optimization (GRPO) strategy, PCQA-R1 first constructs a chain-of-thought dataset, PCQA-CoT, which serves as cold-start training data through a reverse reasoning strategy that teaches the LMM to generate its reasoning process. We further introduce a Gaussian proximity reward that prevents calibration drift by anchoring score predictions to the source MOS range. Experimental results demonstrate that PCQA-R1 achieves state-of-the-art cross-dataset generalization across five benchmarks and competitive in-domain accuracy. Ablation studies support the role of ranking, Gaussian reward, and cold-start traces.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PCQA-R1: 推进通用3D点云质量评估与强化学习
articles.content_zh: 无参考点云质量评估(PCQA)是近年来活跃的话题,用于测量和优化点云的视觉体验. 然而,在这一领域很少探索大型多式联运模式。 以往基于LMM的方法主要依靠有监督的微调来直接预测数字质量分数,缺乏跨数据集的通用能力,且MOS尺度各异,说明有限. 一个关键的困难是,绝对MOS回归可能在不同得分尺度和扭曲分布的数据集之间变得脆弱,而在这种变化中相对质量的排名更为稳定。 在本文中,我们介绍了PCQA-R1,这是第一个用于3D点云质量评估的强化学习LMM,以同时建模质量理解和评分. PCQA-R1在集团相对政策优化策略(GRPO)的基础上,首先构建了一个思维链数据集PCQA-COT,通过一个反向推理策略来教LMM生成推理过程,作为冷启动培训数据. 我们进一步推出高斯近距离奖励,通过将分数预测锁定到源MOS范围来防止校准漂移. 实验结果显示,PCQA-R1在五个基准中实现了最先进的跨数据集通用化,并具有竞争性的域内精确度. 校对研究支持排行榜,高斯奖,以及冷启动痕迹的作用.

articles.title: Evaluation of Image Matching Methods for Visual Odometry on UAVs
articles.content: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are becoming a powerful tool for many environmental monitoring and transport applications. Yet, their reliance on Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) technology for navigation makes them susceptible to catastrophic failures in scenarios where the positioning signal is unavailable or disrupted. This work explores Visual Odometry (VO) as a crucial navigation component. Recently, numerous deep-learning-based methods for image matching have been proposed that are yet to be implemented in a fully-fledged VO system. In this paper, we evaluate recent state-of-the-art image matching methods for the task of VO for UAV position tracking, with a downwards-facing camera, on our synthetic dataset, and find that while the best results are generated by the recent RoMa matcher, SIFT features can outperform some recent state-of-the-art.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 对无人驾驶飞行器上图像匹配方法的评价
articles.content_zh: 无人驾驶飞行器正在成为许多环境监测和运输应用的有力工具。 然而,由于它们依赖全球导航卫星系统的导航技术,在定位信号没有或中断的情况下,它们很容易发生灾难性故障。 这部作品探索了Visual Odometry(VO)作为关键导航组件. 最近,提出了许多基于深入学习的图像匹配方法,尚未在一个成熟的VO系统中实施。 在本文中,我们评价最近用于UAV位置跟踪的VO任务的最新最新图像匹配方法,在我们的合成数据集上用一个向下显示的相机,并发现虽然最近的RoMa匹配器产生了最佳结果,但SIFT的特性可以超越一些最近的最新最新最新技术.

articles.title: PALATE: Personalized Aesthetic Learning through Adaptive Taste Evolution for Multi-User Portrait Retouching
articles.content: Automatic portrait retouching has advanced rapidly, yet its objective is inherently subjective: the same portrait admits multiple professionally valid results, and users disagree about which one is best. Most existing methods optimize a population-level aesthetic standard and therefore cannot capture individual taste, while fine-tuning a separate editing model for every user incurs prohibitive training, storage, and data costs. We propose PALATE, a shared reward-evolution framework that keeps the image editor fixed and instead personalizes the selection among retouched candidates of the same source portrait. PALATE decomposes the reward for each user into a global backbone shared by all users, category-level residuals shared by aesthetically similar users, and a lightweight user adapter, with anti-collapse regularizers keeping the three levels complementary.A cyclic dual-level distillation scheme first distills user-specific preferences into category rewards and then consolidates the resulting category-level knowledge into the global backbone, which is redistributed to initialize the next evolution round. In this way, the shared initialization improves progressively across rounds, enabling unseen users to be calibrated from only a few rankings. On expert-retouched candidates from PPR10K with held-out users and held-out images, PALATE attains 72.83% pairwise preference-prediction accuracy, surpassing all reward, aesthetic, and image-quality baselines, of which the strongest, PickScore, reaches 58.06%. Each new user costs only 512 bytes of user-specific parameters and millisecond-level scoring.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PALATE:通过适应性的味道进化来进行个性化的美学学习,用于多用户肖像修补
articles.content_zh: 自动肖像重修迅速推进,然而其目标却内在主观:同一张肖像承认多种专业上有效的结果,用户对哪一个最好持不同意见. 大多数现有方法都优化了人口一级的审美标准,因此无法捕捉到个人的口味,而对每个用户的单独编辑模式进行微调则需付出高昂的培训、存储和数据成本。 我们提出PALATE, 一个共同的奖励-进化框架, PALATE将每个用户的奖励分解为所有用户共享的全球骨干,美学上相似用户共享的类别级剩余,以及一个轻量级用户适配器,反缩合常态器保持三级互补. 循环双层蒸馏计划首先将用户特有的偏好提炼成类别奖励,然后将由此产生的类别级知识整合到全球骨干中,再进行再分配以初始化下一个演化回合. 这样,共享初始化在跨回合之间逐渐改进,使得看不见的用户能够从少数排名中校准. 在PPR10K有被搁置用户和被搁置图像的专家候选人中,PALATE获得了72.83%的双向偏好预测精度,超过了所有奖励、美学和图像质量基线,其中最强者PickScore达到58.06%。 每个新用户只花费512字节的用户特定参数和毫秒级评分.

articles.title: SPARC: Slice-to-volume Pipeline for Automated Reconstruction of gated 3D+time fetal Cardiac MRI
articles.content: Fetal cardiac MRI (fCMR) provides valuable diagnostic information complementary to echocardiography, particularly for complex congenital heart disease (CHD). Dynamic cine imaging captures cardiac motion essential for assessment of cardiac function; however, the reconstruction of 3D+time cine volumes from 2D+time acquired slices remains challenging due to unpredictable fetal motion and the absence of automated and robust processing tools suitable for clinical deployment. We present the SPARC pipeline (Slice-to-volume Pipeline for Automated Reconstruction of gated 3D+time fetal Cardiac MRI) which combines physics-informed slice-to-volume reconstruction (SVR) of Doppler ultrasound (DUS) gated stacks of slices, assisted by deep learning (DL) models for thoracic segmentation and anatomical reorientation. The proposed SVR algorithm achieves a tenfold reduction in reconstruction time relative to existing frame-wise approaches ($4.8 \pm 1.0$ vs $49.0 \pm 14.1$ min, $p < 0.0001$) while improving the reconstruction quality. Thoracic segmentation performance using ensemble aggregation exceeded inter-rater agreement (Dice $84.7 \pm 3.9\%$ vs $81.4 \pm 7.7\%$, $p<0.05$), while anatomical reorientation achieved a success rate of $90.1\%$. End-to-end evaluation on a large held-out clinical cohort ($n = 121$) demonstrated fully automatic processing in $82.6\%$ of cases with a mean runtime of $7.1 \pm 1.3$ min, compatible with clinical deployment. The complete SPARC pipeline is publicly available as a Docker container https://hub.docker.com/r/aboutill/sparc and is currently deployed at our institution as a clinical research tool.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SPARC:用于自动重建3D+时门胎心磁共振管的切片对容量管道
articles.content_zh: 胎儿心脏核磁共振(fCMR)提供了宝贵的诊断信息,补充了回声心电学,特别是复杂的先天性心脏病。 动态焚化成像捕捉对评估心脏功能至关重要的心脏运动;然而,由于胎儿运动不可预测以及缺乏适合临床应用的自动和稳健处理工具,从2D+时间获得的切片中重建3D+时间焚化体量仍然具有挑战性。 我们提出SPARC管道(自动重建门式3D+时间胎心核磁共振管),该管道结合了多普勒超声波(DUS)门式堆积切片的物理知情切片重建(SVR),辅以深层学习(DL)模型,用于胸膜分裂和解剖调整。 拟议的SVR算法比现行帧法减少了10倍的重建时间(4.8美元=1.0美元=49.0美元=14.1 min,$p < 0.0001美元),同时提高了重建质量. 使用综艺聚合的色拉西分解性能超过了结对协议(Dice 84.7\pm 3.9\p$vs 81.4\pm 7.7\p$,p<0.05$),而解剖调整成功率为90.1\$. 对大批被搁置的临床人群的端到端评价(n = 121美元)显示,在82.6美元病例中,完全自动处理,平均运行时间为7.1美元,每分钟1.3美元,与临床部署相符。 完整的SPARC管道作为Docker容器https://hub.docker.com/r/aboutill/sparc公开提供,目前作为临床研究工具部署在我们机构。

articles.title: CDGP: Contrastive Dual Gaussian Processes for Weakly Supervised Anomaly Segmentation
articles.content: Industrial visual inspection must both decide whether a product is defective and localize the defect, yet pixel-level masks are costly to collect at scale. Most anomaly-segmentation methods learn only from defect-free images and score deviations from normality. A true defect and an unusual-but-normal region, however, can both deviate substantially and receive similarly high scores. We propose Contrastive Dual Gaussian Processes (CDGP), a weakly supervised framework that models normal and anomaly inducing-variable predictive distributions over dense tokens. Its posterior-dominance statistic standardizes their predictive-mean difference by the joint predictive uncertainty, providing both spatial evidence and image-level confidence. This evidence complements hierarchical normal-reconstruction residuals for fine localization. All calibration uses training data only, without human pixel annotations or test-time fitting. Across MVTec AD~2, KSDD2, and VisA, CDGP ranks first among the evaluated methods on all MVTec AD~2 localization metrics and is first-place or competitive on KSDD2 and VisA. Factorized and matched linear-head controls delimit the contribution and scope of the linear-kernel Gaussian process (GP) formulation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CDGP: 弱监督异常分裂的双高斯进程对比
articles.content_zh: 工业视觉检查必须既决定产品是否有缺陷,又将缺陷本地化,然而像素级的口罩要大规模收集成本高昂. 大多数异常分化方法只从无缺陷图像中学习,分数偏离常态. 然而,真正的缺陷和异常但正常的区域既可能发生重大偏离,也可能得到同样高的分数。 我们提议采用对比双高斯工艺(CDGP),这是一种由弱监督的框架,用以模拟正常和异常诱导的可变预测分布于稠密信号上。 它的后置主力统计通过共同的预测不确定性使其预测-实际差异标准化,既提供了空间证据,也提供了图像水平的信心. 这一证据补充了等级式的正常重建剩余部分,用于精细的本地化. 所有校准都只使用训练数据,没有人类像素说明或测试时间的配置. 在整个MVTec AD~2,KSDD2和VisA中,CDGP在所有MVTec AD~2本地化度量表上被评价的方法中排名第一,在KSDD2和VisA上处于第一位或具有竞争力. 参数化和匹配的线头控制划定线内核高斯工艺配方的贡献和范围.

articles.title: VA-Judger: Reward Modeling from Human Preference Feedback for Joint Video-Audio Generation
articles.content: Using reinforcement learning to post-train joint video-audio generation models requires a reward signal. Existing methods construct this reward by combining metrics for individual quality dimensions, including audio quality, visual fidelity, and synchronization. However, these metrics evaluate perceptual dimensions separately and fail to capture the overall semantic and temporal coherence among the text prompt, video, and audio that shapes human preferences. Optimizing models against these metrics encourages reward hacking, generating video-audio content that achieves high scores on these metrics yet appears incoherent or unfaithful to human viewers. To address this problem, we first construct a large-scale human-preference dataset VAPref-10K for joint video-audio generation, comprising 9K prompts and 10.3K fine-grained paired comparisons from open-source generation models. We also introduce the VA-Judger-Bench benchmark with both in-domain and out-of-domain model comparisons to evaluate whether reward models truly align with human preferences. We further propose VA-Judger, a chain-of-thought omni-reward model for joint video-audio generation. In particular, VA-Judger first learns from pairs with clear quality gaps to establish structured output and coarse preference discrimination, then distills reliable preference explanations for harder near-quality comparisons via rejection sampling verified against human annotations, and finally performs dimension-wise reinforcement learning that decomposes human feedback into individual quality dimensions for denser reward signals than a single binary preference label. Experiments show that VA-Judger outperforms metric baselines in predicting human preferences on both in-domain and out-of-domain evaluations. Using its human-aligned rewards for post-training audio-video generation model also yields significant improvements in generation quality.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VA-法官:从人类喜好反馈中为联合视频-音频生成提供奖励
articles.content_zh: 利用强化学习在训练后联合视频-音频生成模型需要奖励信号. 现有方法通过综合个人质量维度的衡量标准,包括音频质量、视觉忠诚度和同步度来构建这种奖励。 然而,这些度量衡分别评价了知觉维度,未能捕捉形成人类喜好的文本即时,视频,音频之间的整体语义和时间一致性. 与这些度量标准相比,优化模型鼓励奖励黑客,生成视频-音频内容,在这些度量标准上达到高分,然而对于人类观众来说却显得不一致或不忠实. 为了解决这个问题,我们首先为联合视频-音频生成构建了大规模人文参考数据集VAPref-10K,包括9K提示和10.3K从开源生成模型中精细的配对比较. 我们还采用了具有域内和域外模式比较的VA-Judger-Bench基准,以评估奖励模式是否真正符合人类偏好。 我们进一步提议VA-Judger,一个联合视频-音频生成的连锁全能奖模式。 特别是,VA-法官首先从质量差距明显的对子中学习,以确定结构化的输出和粗厚的偏好歧视,然后通过拒绝抽样对照人类说明进行更硬的近质量比较,提炼出可靠的偏好解释,最后进行量位强化学习,将人类反馈分解为个人质量维度,比单一的二进制偏好标签更密集的奖励信号. 实验显示,在预测人类对内和领域外评价的偏好方面,VA-Judger在衡量基线方面优于业绩。 利用其对培训后音频视频生成模式的与人相称的奖励,也大大提高了生成质量。

articles.title: Teach a Molmo2Fish: Towards interactive fish tracking with natural language guidance
articles.content: Computer vision is increasingly used to automate recognition tasks in large ecological datasets, but more complex tasks such as multi-object tracking continue to pose challenges. As researchers seek to incorporate vision models in ecology workflows, various lines of research have explored how to make imperfect predictions useful through human-in-the-loop processes. We propose a new approach to working with imperfect tracking predictions through an interactive prediction correction workflow taking place as a conversation with a multimodal large language model, which we tailor to a sonar fish tracking dataset as an initial proof of concept. We investigate the performance of the tool, Molmo2Fish, across guided and unguided tasks, correcting its own predicted tracks and external tracks. We find that Molmo2Fish achieves high performance on fish tracking and track correction tasks, but there is still much room to improve on incorporating natural language guidance. The code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/tidalove/molmo2fish.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 教一个摩尔莫2 鱼类:采用自然语言指导的互动鱼类跟踪
articles.content_zh: 计算机视觉在大型生态数据集中越来越多地用于自动化识别任务,但多对象跟踪等更为复杂的任务继续构成挑战. 随着研究人员寻求将愿景模型纳入生态工作流程,各种研究领域都探索了如何通过人与人之间的“即时”过程使不完善预测有用。 我们提出一种新的方法,通过交互式的预测校正工作流程与不完善的跟踪预测合作,该工作流程是与一个多模式的大型语言模型的对话,我们根据声纳鱼跟踪数据集进行调整,作为概念的初步证明。 我们调查工具"Molmo2Fish"的性能,跨过有指引和无指引的任务,修正它自己的预测轨道和外部轨道. 我们发现Molmo2Fish在鱼追踪和跟踪校正任务上取得了高性能,但在纳入自然语言指导方面仍有很大的改进余地. 该代码和数据可在https://github.com/tidalove/molmo2fish上公开查阅。

articles.title: ReX-Shot: Single-Image Rephotography via Geometry- and Camera-Grounded Generation
articles.content: Single-image rephotography aims to synthesize new shots of a scene from a single reference image with specified viewpoints, focal lengths, and photographic effects, which are intrinsically coupled in imaging. Existing methods typically treat these factors separately and struggle under joint control: novel-view synthesis may introduce geometric distortions under focal-length changes, while super-resolution and instruction-guided editing remain confined to 2D and cannot reliably extend detail restoration or appearance control to novel viewpoints. We attribute these limitations to imperfect single-image 3D reconstruction and the sampling limit of continuous focal-length enlargement. To reduce projection bias from geometric errors, we use implicitly transformed foundation-model features for robust target-view guidance. We further formulate focal-length enlargement as a geometry-guided super-resolution problem and exploit generative detail priors to recover details lost during sparse 3D resampling. Built on this 3D-aware generative backbone, we lift photographic-effect control from 2D filtering to 3D-aware appearance editing, preserving content consistency across viewpoints and focal lengths. These components form ReX-Shot, a geometry- and camera-grounded generative framework for single-image rephotography. To our knowledge, ReX-Shot is the first unified framework to jointly control viewpoint, focal length, and parameterized photographic effects from a single image. Experiments show that ReX-Shot outperforms representative baselines across all three controls while enabling near-real-time interactive rephotography.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ReX-Shot:通过几何和相机组合生成的单图像重影
articles.content_zh: 单一图像再摄影的目的是从单一的参考图像中合成一个场景的新镜头,具有特定的观点,焦距,以及摄影效果,这些效果在成像中是内在结合的. 现有方法通常在共同控制下分别处理这些因素并进行斗争:新视觉合成可能在焦距变化下引入几何扭曲,而超分辨率和指令制导编辑仍局限于2D,无法可靠地将细节恢复或外观控制延伸到新观点. 我们把这些限制归因于不完美的单像立体重建以及连续焦距扩展的采样极限. 为了减少几何误差的投影偏差,我们使用隐含变换的基建模型特性来进行强健的目标-视野引导. 我们进一步将焦距扩展定为几何制导的超解问题,并利用基因细节前科,以恢复在稀疏的3D重采样过程中丢失的细节。 由这个3D-意识基因骨干构建,我们把摄影效果控制从2D滤波器提升到3D-意识外观编辑,在观点和焦距上保持内容一致性. 这些组件组成了ReX-Shot,一个几何和相机定位的单像重摄影基因框架. 据我们所知,Rex-Shot是第一个从单一图像中联合控制视角、焦距和参数化摄影效果的统一框架。 实验显示,REX-Shot超越了所有三种控制中的代表性基线,同时实现了近实时交互式再照相.

articles.title: FD-CanKD: Frequency-Decoupled Cross-Attention Distillation as a Refinement Prior for Compact Object Detectors
articles.content: Compact object detectors are suitable for resource-constrained visual perception, but their limited representation capacity creates an accuracy gap relative to large models. Conventional detector distillation often relies on prediction-level supervision or a single feature-alignment target, such as response, distribution, correlation, or frequency-domain matching. Frequency-Decoupled Cross-Attention Knowledge Distillation (FD-CanKD) is presented as a detector-oriented framework that transfers teacher knowledge at three complementary levels: head-level prediction supervision, relation-level non-local context transfer, and frequency-level component-selective alignment. Student features first aggregate teacher-side spatial context through cross-attention-based relation transfer, after which frequency-aware alignment preserves complementary structural and detail-sensitive cues. Under controlled Microsoft Common Objects in Context (COCO) experiments, fixed 50-epoch from-scratch comparisons show that FD-CanKD remains competitive with representative detector knowledge distillation baselines. Post-distillation continued fine-tuning further produces a stronger refinement-ready student than detector-only fine-tuning, reaching 48.87 mean average precision (mAP) at intersection-over-union thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95 (mAP50:95), 65.84 mAP50, and 53.40 mAP75 after 20 additional epochs. All distillation modules are removed after training, leaving the deployed student unchanged at 19.7M parameters. The framework is instantiated and evaluated in a controlled YOLOv12 teacher-student setting as a representative compact-detector case study.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FD-CanKD: 压缩对象探测器先于精度减频的交叉加速蒸馏
articles.content_zh: 收缩对象探测器适合资源受限的视觉感知,但其有限的表现能力相对于大型模型造成了精度差距. 常规的探测器蒸馏往往依赖于预测级监督或单一的特征对齐目标,如反应,分布,相关性,或频率域匹配. 频率十进制交叉留守知识疏导(FD-CanKD)被介绍为以探测器为导向的框架,在三个互补层面转移教师知识:头级预测监督,关系级非局部背景转移,频率级组件选择性调整. 学生首先通过跨注意力型关系转移来综合师方空间背景,之后频率感知对调保留了互补的结构和细节感知提示. 在上下文(COCO)控制下的微软共同对象实验中,固定的50个时间段的切片比较显示,FD-CanKD仍然具有具有代表性的探测器知识蒸馏基线的竞争力. 蒸馏后继续微调,进一步培养出比探测器仅微调更强的精度准备生,在交汇过关阈值从0.50到0.95(mAP50:95),65.84 mAP50,以及53.40 mAP75之后,达到48.87的平均精度(mAP). 所有蒸馏模块在训练后被移除,使部署的学生在19.7M参数上保持不变. 在受控制的YOLOv12师生环境中,该框架作为具有代表性的紧凑探测器案例研究进行了即时评估。

articles.title: OmniHandwritingOCR: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal LLMs in Handwritten OCR Scenarios
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used as OCR systems in document and knowledge-processing pipelines, but their ability to faithfully read real handwriting remains underexplored. Existing OCR benchmarks focus largely on printed text or clean single-line inputs, leaving limited coverage of realistic handwritten OCR scenarios such as multilingual handwriting, writer errors, and structurally complex mathematical expressions. We introduce OmniHandwritingOCR, a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating MLLMs and OCR systems on handwritten OCR. It covers handwritten text recognition and handwritten mathematical expression recognition across six subtasks and twelve subsets, totaling 77.57K labeled images from public datasets and newly collected student writings. A key component is a difficulty-stratified multi-line formula corpus designed to test robustness under increasing structural complexity. We evaluate thirteen open- and closed-source systems with five complementary metrics under a unified protocol. Results show that current systems remain far from faithful transcription: performance drops sharply on complex multi-line formulas, model rankings vary across language and formula settings, and several generative models hallucinate plausible but visually unsupported corrections. OmniHandwritingOCR provides a challenging testbed for diagnosing language, content, structural, and visual-grounding failure modes of multimodal models in handwritten OCR scenarios.

articles.title_zh: OmniHandwritingOCR:手写OCR情景中评价多式联运有限责任公司的诊断基准
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)在文件和知识处理管道中越来越多地作为OCR系统使用,但其忠实读取真实笔迹的能力仍然没有得到充分利用. 现有的OCR基准主要侧重于印刷文本或干净的单行输入,使得现实的手写OCR情景的覆盖范围有限,如多语种笔迹,写作错误,以及结构复杂的数学表达. 我们采用OmniHandwritingOCR,这是手写OCR上评价MLLM和OCR系统的诊断基准. 它涵盖手写文字识别和手写数学表达式识别,跨越6个子任务和12个子集,总计来自公共数据集的77.57K标签图像和新收集的学生著作. 一个关键组成部分是在结构日益复杂的情况下测试稳健性的多线性公式体。 我们评价13个开源和闭源系统,在统一的协议下有5个补充度量标准。 结果显示,目前的系统仍然远远没有忠实的抄录:在复杂的多行公式上,性能急剧下降,模型的排名因语言和公式设置而异,一些基因模型产生假象,但视而不见的校正. OmniHandwritingOCR提供了一个具有挑战性的测试台,用于在手写OCR情景中诊断多种模式的语言,内容,结构和视觉定位故障模式.

articles.title: SPARC: Subspace Position-Aware Robust Few-Shot Calibration for Distribution-Shifted Industrial Anomaly Detection
articles.content: Vision-based industrial anomaly detectors are calibrated on one distribution but may be deployed on another that differs in illumination, fixture placement, or sensor characteristics, sharply degrading an otherwise accurate detector. Adapting to the incoming lot is a natural response, but labeled anomalies are scarce. We therefore consider calibration using only a handful of verified-normal images available before scoring the rest of the lot. Existing fixes require backpropagation, detector-specific tuning, or choices about feature directions that few calibration samples cannot justify. We present SPARC, a few-shot calibration method that intercepts patch features between encoder and detector and removes a closed-form, spatially indexed estimate of deployment-time nuisance through per-cell subspace projection. It needs only $k \le 8$ verified-normal images and uses the algebraic saturation rank $r{=}k{-}1$ on the encoder's native patch grid. The correction requires no gradient or weight updates and works with memory-bank, density, prototype, and mutual detectors. On the shift-prone benchmarks, SPARC improves pooled Image AUROC and AU-PRO$_{0.3}$ for all seven detectors whose image scores depend on corrected patch features by $+13.8$ and $+3.5$ percentage points (pp), respectively; on benchmarks without engineered shift, the changes are small and mixed. Controls that give competing corrections the same calibration images attribute these gains to the per-cell subspace structure rather than the images alone. Further ablations support the saturation-rank choice and characterize sensitivity to backbone and calibration conditions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SPARC: 用于分布式散射式工业异常检测的子空间位置- 智能强力
articles.content_zh: 基于视觉的工业异常探测器在一个分布上进行校准,但可能部署在另一个在照明、固定放置或传感器特性上有所不同,使本来准确的探测器急剧降低。 适应即将到来的数量是自然反应,但标签上的异常很少. 因此,我们考虑仅使用少数可核实的正常图像进行校准,然后对其余的地图进行评分。 现存的修补方法需要反射,检测器特定的调试,或者选择一些无法证明校准样本合理性的特征方向. 我们提出SPARC,一种几发校准方法,它拦截编码器和探测器之间的补丁特性,并通过每个细胞的子空间投影去除一个闭合形式,空间索引化的部署时间扰动估计. 它只需要$k\le 8$验证的正常图像,并在编码器的本地补丁网格上使用代数饱和级$r{=}k{-}1$. 校正不需要梯度或重量更新,并与内存库、密度、原型和相互探测器配合。 在易转向基准方面,SPARC改进了集合图像AUROC和AU-PRO$_{0.3}$,这七个探测器的图像分数取决于校正的补丁特性,分别为+13.8美元和+3.5美元百分点(pp);在没有设计转向的基准方面,变化很小,而且有好有坏。 给予相互竞争的校准图像的控件将这些增益归因于每个细胞的子空间结构,而不仅仅是图像. 进一步的沉积支持饱和等级选择,并描述对骨干和校准条件的敏感性。

articles.title: MR-IQA-2: Faithful Image Quality Reflection via Fine-Grained Credit Assignment
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for image quality assessment (IQA) by improving consistency between quality ratings and their underlying reasoning. However, most approaches supervise reasoning through human-provided ratings and rarely examine whether it faithfully reflects image quality. Rating accuracy alone does not ensure faithful reasoning; a shared reward also obscures supervision sources and may reinforce unfaithful reasoning when a correct rating occurs by chance. To improve the faithfulness and reliability of blind IQA, we aim to (1) decouple credit assignment for reasoning and rating and (2) provide verifiable supervision for faithful reasoning. We introduce MR-IQA-2, an actor-editor-judge framework that operationalizes reasoning-editing-reflection. The actor generates quality reasoning for an input image, and the editor revises the image according to the identified quality factors. A frozen judge compares the original and edited images and provides reflective supervision for the actor's reasoning. MR-IQA-2 further uses fine-grained credit assignment to decouple reasoning and rating supervision. Judge feedback supervises reasoning, whereas human ratings supervise the predicted rating. Masked token-specific updates distinguish these signals while preserving the causal relation from reasoning to rating. Across IQA benchmarks, MR-IQA-2 achieves competitive rating alignment with humans. Visual reflection also enables richer and more faithful visual understanding beyond rating, which may inform image-quality optimization and related downstream tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/RobinY99/MR-IQA-2.

articles.title_zh: MR-IQA-2:通过精益求精的信用分配,忠实的图像质量反思
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)通过提高质量评级与其基本推理的一致性,显示出图像质量评估的强大潜力. 然而,大多数方法通过人提供的评级来监督推理,很少检查它是否忠实地反映了图像质量. 仅仅评定准确性并不能确保忠实的推理;共同的奖励也掩盖了监督来源,并可能在偶然作出正确评定时加强不忠实的推理。 为了提高盲目IQA的忠诚度和可靠性,我们的目标是:(1) 将推理和评级的信用分配解密,(2) 为忠实推理提供可核查的监督. 我们介绍了MR-IQA-2,这是一个演员-编辑-法官框架,可操作推理-编辑-反演。 演员为输入图像生成质量推理,编辑者根据识别的质量因素修改图像. 被冻结的法官对原作和编辑的图像进行比较,并为演员的推理提供反射监督. MR-IQA-2进一步使用精细的信用分配来解析推理和评级监督. 法官的反馈监督推理,而人类的评级则监督预测的评级. 蒙面标志特定更新区分这些信号,同时保留因果关系从推理到评级. 在整个IQA基准中,MR-IQA-2实现了与人类的竞争性评级一致. 视觉反射还能够使视觉理解超越评级,更丰富和更忠实,为图像质量优化和相关下游任务提供信息。 代码见https://github.com/RobinY99/MR-IQA-2.

articles.title: PATE-Forensics: Perception-as-Tool for Explainable Deepfake Forensics with General-Purpose MLLMs
articles.content: Existing explainable deepfake forensic methods typically rely on task-adapted MLLM to jointly address detection, localization, and explanation. Inspired by agent-style tool use, we instead introduce a Perception-as-Tool paradigm and instantiate it as PATE-Forensics, which architecturally decouples detection and localization from explanation generation while coupling detection and localization as tightly as possible within a forensic perception tool. The DINOv3-based tool couples a multi-granularity detection module that integrates global, patch-level, and segment-level evidence with a cue-guided localization module by spatializing the patch-level and segment-level evidence into forgery score maps that guide dense mask prediction. The original image and forensic perception outputs produced by the tool form structured forensic context for a general-purpose MLLM, which is guided by prompt constraints to generate explanations without task-specific fine-tuning. On DDL-X Track 3, PATE-Forensics achieves the best official score of 0.89, outperforming the second-ranked team by 0.19 points. Our code is available at https://github.com/yqli00000/PATE-Forensics.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PATE - 法医:用通用MLLMs进行解释性深层法证的感知工具
articles.content_zh: 现有的可解释的深层法证方法通常依靠经过任务调整的MLLM来共同解决检测、本地化和解释问题。 在使用代理式工具的启发下,我们引入了一种Perception-as-Tool范式,并将其即时化为PATE-Forensics,在建筑上将探测和本地化与解释生成脱钩,同时在法证认知工具中尽可能紧密地结合探测和本地化. 基于DINOv3的工具配对一个多角度检测模块,将全球,补丁级和段级证据与提示引导本地化模块结合,将补丁级和段级证据空间化为可引导密集遮罩预测的伪造分数地图. 该工具制作的原始图像和法证感知输出为一种通用的MLLM形成结构化的法证背景,它以迅速的限制为指导,生成解释而无需针对特定任务的微调. 在DDL-X Track 3上,PATE-Forensics取得了0.89的最好官方分数,比排名第二的球队成绩高0.19分. 我们的代码可以在https://github.com/yqli000/PATE-Forensics上找到.

articles.title: SemanticSlider3D: Training-Free Continuous Semantic Editing for 3D Objects
articles.content: Fine-grained control over continuous semantic attributes of 3D objects is essential for 3D content creation, but is not well supported by conventional 3D modeling workflows or prompt-based interaction with existing generative AI tools. While slider-based methods have proven effective for fine-grained semantic control in 2D image generation, no equivalent approach exists for 3D. Extending these 2D methods to 3D is non-trivial due to challenges unique to 3D, including geometric integrity and cross-view coherence. We present SemanticSlider3D, a technique for continuous semantic attribute editing of 3D objects that requires no per-attribute training. Given a user-specified attribute, our pipeline constructs a semantic editing direction in the latent space of a state-of-the-art 3D generation model, presenting a diverse and coherent spectrum of 3D variations. A technical validation on a dataset of 50 3D object-attribute pairs shows our method was preferred by all five human assessors across variation range, consistency, 3D object quality, and attribute disentanglement, over a baseline combining a 2D slider with an image-to-3D model. An exploratory study with six participants demonstrates that SemanticSlider3D supported decision-making in 3D prototyping and was perceived as a valuable addition to existing workflows.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语义Slider3D:3D对象的无训练连续语义编辑
articles.content_zh: 对3D对象连续语义属性的精细控制对于3D内容的创建至关重要,但没有得到常规的3D建模工作流程或与现有基因AI工具的即时交互支持. 虽然基于滑动器的方法在2D图像生成中已被证明对精细纹理语义控制有效,但对3D却不存在等效的方法. 由于3D特有的挑战,包括几何完整性和交叉视野一致性,将这些2D方法扩展至3D是非三角性的. 我们提出了语义Slider3D,一种连续语义属性编辑3D对象的技术,不需要对每个属性进行培训. 鉴于用户指定的属性,我们的管道在最先进的3D生成模型的潜在空间中构建了语义编辑方向,呈现出多种和一致的3D变体. 在50个3D对象属性对的数据集上的技术验证显示,我们的方法被所有5名人类评估员所偏爱,它们跨越变异范围、一致性、3D对象质量和属性的分散,而不是一个将2D滑轮与图像到3D模型相结合的基线。 一项有6名与会者参与的探索性研究表明,语义Slider3D支持3D原型中的决策,被认为是对现有工作流程的宝贵补充.

articles.title: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments
articles.content: Continuous self-improvement requires an ever-expanding pool of self-generated, diverse, adaptive goals. For language agents, existing training environment pools (hand-curated, statically synthesized, or frozen-verifier) keep the goal distribution fixed as the learner scales. We introduce SPADE (Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments), a self-play RL framework in which a single LLM plays two roles: an Environment Designer that writes complete, long-horizon training environments as executable code with an OpenAI Gym-style reset()/step() interface, and a Reasoning Agent that learns to act in them. Each is a stateful, multi-turn environment (state transitions, reward functions, and verification code), so one interface spans reasoning problems and multi-step agentic tool use. The Reasoning Agent's regret is estimated using the gap between its reward with and without privileged hints; in optimizing this regret signal the Environment Designer learns to target environments at the edge of the agent's capabilities while keeping them feasible. Through extensive experimentation, we find several components critical to success: grounding the Environment Designer on documents sampled from a large pretraining corpus, and giving it an accumulated environment memory. Scaling to 30B-parameter models, SPADE improves over the strongest fixed-environment baseline by +5.3 on average across eight held-out math, science, code, and reasoning benchmarks, and lifts the tool-use setting by +5.7 on BFCL-v4 multi-turn and +13.9 on ACEBench-Agent; on the games setting, the margin over the strongest baseline grows with model scale. By making environment design itself a learnable component, SPADE takes a concrete step toward open-ended self-improvement.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SPADE: 适应性合成环境中的自玩
articles.content_zh: 不断的自我改进需要不断扩展的自我产生、多样化和适应性目标。 对于语言代理商,现有的培训环境池(手加工、静态合成或冷冻-核查)将目标分布固定为学习者比例。 我们引入了 SPADE (Self-Play in Adapensive Synthetic Exceptable Environments),这是一个自玩的 RL 框架,其中单个 LLM 扮演两个角色: 一个环境设计师,用 OpenAI Gym 风格的重置()/ step() 接口将完整,长宽的训练环境写成可执行代码,另一个是学习在其中行动的理性代理. 每个都是一种状态的,多回合的环境(状态过渡,奖励函数,和校验代码),所以一个界面跨越推理问题和多步代理工具的使用. "理性代理人"的遗憾估计是利用它的奖励与没有特权提示之间的差距;在优化这一遗憾信号时,环境设计师学会了将环境瞄准代理人能力边缘,同时保持其可行性. 通过广泛的试验,我们发现若干对成功至关重要的组成部分:将环境设计师放在从一个大型预训书中取样的文件上,并赋予它积累的环境记忆。 SPADE在30B参数模型中,在8个搁置的数学、科学、代码和推理基准中,平均将最强的固定环境基线提高+5.3,并在BFCL-v4多转和ACEBench-Agent上将工具使用设置提升+5.7;在游戏设定中,比最强基线的比值随着模型规模的增长。 通过使环境设计本身成为可学习的组成部分,促进环境和发展协会在走向开放的自我改善方面迈出了具体步骤。

articles.title: Beyond Teacher Likelihood: Group-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation for Long-Context Reasoning
articles.content: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own responses using dense token-level guidance from a stronger teacher. In long-context tasks, however, token-level teacher support can favor locally plausible responses that omit evidence distributed across the input or violate global task constraints. Task-specific verifiers, in contrast, evaluate task completion at the response level and may return graded rewards that reflect partial success. We diagnose this mismatch on fixed responses from two representative long-context evidence-aggregation tasks. Across longer input ranges, trajectory-level OPD scores become progressively less aligned with verifier rewards, indicating teacher-verifier disagreement. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Group-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation (GC-OPD). GC-OPD separately normalizes verifier rewards and trajectory-level OPD scores within each rollout group and uses their difference as a signed teacher-verifier disagreement residual. Relative-advantage-based credit assignment (RACA) distributes this trajectory-level residual across tokens according to their relative OPD advantages while preserving the original OPD signal. Across five long-context benchmarks, post-training with GC-OPD raises the five-benchmark averages of the official Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B checkpoints from 29.08 to 40.47 and from 35.12 to 44.65, respectively. Vanilla OPD reaches 39.31 and 43.56 under the same setup. Controlled ablations show that the signed residual is more effective than either an additional OPD-derived term or direct group-normalized verifier reward addition, while RACA further improves over uniform token allocation. Together, these results demonstrate that group-relative residual calibration can incorporate verifier outcomes without discarding dense token-level guidance. Code is available at https://github.com/SolereZhang/GC-OPD.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Beyond Teacher Likelihood:为长文解释而解析的政策问题
articles.content_zh: 政策蒸馏(OpD)利用更强的老师的密集符号级指导,对学生进行自己的响应训练. 然而,在长文任务中,象征性的教师支持可以支持地方上可行的反应,这些反应忽略了在投入中分发的证据,或者违反了全球任务限制。 与此相反,针对具体任务的核查人员在应对层面评价任务完成情况,并可能退回反映部分成功情况的分级奖励。 我们从两个具有代表性的长文证据汇总任务中判断出这种不匹配。 在整个较长的输入范围,轨迹级OPD分数与核实者奖励越来越不一致,表明教师与核实者有分歧。 基于这一看法,我们引入了小组分析的政策问题消化(GC-OPD)。 GC-OPD将每个推出组内的校对者奖励和轨迹级OPD分数分别正常化,并将其差数用作签名的教师-校对者分歧残数. 基于相对优势的信用分配(RACA)在保留原OPD信号的同时,根据它们相对的OPD优势,将这一轨迹级的剩余物分布在符号之间. 在5个长篇基准中,使用GC-OPD进行的培训后,将官方Qune3-4B和Qune3-8B检查站的5个基准平均数分别从29.08个提高到40.47个和35.12个提高到44.65个。 香草OPD在同一设置下达到39.31和43.56. 受控的擦伤表明,所签名的剩余物比附加OPD衍生的术语或直接的团体规范核查员的奖励添加更有效,而RACA则比统一符号分配进一步改进. 这些结果共同表明,群体相关残留校准可以纳入核查结果,而不放弃密集的符号级指导。 代码见https://github.com/SolereZhang/GC-OPD.

articles.title: ChildSafeAds Shared Task 2026: Commercial Content in Child-Facing YouTube Videos
articles.content: ChildSafeAds is a shared task on commercial content in YouTube videos likely to reach children and teenagers. It contains 3,360 videos from 939 channels. Each instance begins with a segment submitted to SponsorBlock, an open-source crowdsourced browser extension whose users mark sponsor segments so that others can skip them. We pair the segment with its available transcript, video and channel information, and a sales or service page linked from the video description. Systems determine what kind of offer is being promoted (ST1), assign product categories (ST2), and identify legal risk flags (ST3). The evidence is divided into four cumulative access levels, from the transcript to the linked page, so results can be compared against the cost of collecting the data. 45.5\% of videos in our data failed to properly use the in-platform ad disclosure method (the ``Includes paid promotion'' label). GPT-5.4 produced the labels after the expert organiser team reviewed samples and iterated on the taxonomy, prompts and model choices. GPT-5.6-luna independently labelled the development set. This report describes the task, data and evaluation. An updated version will add participating systems and shared-task results.

articles.title: Comment-level Topic Drift Analysis in the Reddit Corpus
articles.content: We present a novel application of embedding-based dynamic topic modeling techniques to detect and quantify topic drift at the comment level in a massive corpus. By leveraging pretrained language models to generate contextualized semantic embeddings for short text, we analyzed 12.7 billion Reddit comments spanning 2006 to 2022. Using unsupervised methods on these embeddings, we identify dynamically evolving topic clusters over time. Our primary contribution is a methodology for analysis of semantic drift and discourse evolution in the embedding space itself. We also demonstrate modifications to existing methods that enable this analysis at scale, and we propose and demonstrate a null model comparison test to filter spurious dynamics. Key findings suggest that politically and socially contentious topics exhibit significant directional drift in embedding space, with inter-topic distances changing systematically over time beyond what the null model can explain, whereas domains such as music and sports remain comparatively stable.

articles.title_zh: Reddit 公司中的主题漂流分析
articles.content_zh: 我们提出了基于嵌入的动态主题建模技术的新应用,以在评论层面发现和量化一个大规模主题漂移。 通过利用预先训练的语言模型来生成背景化的语义嵌入为短文本,我们分析了127亿Reddit的评论,从2006年到2022年. 在这些嵌入物上采用不受监督的方法,我们确定随着时间推移而动态演变的专题组。 我们的主要贡献是分析嵌入空间本身的语义漂移和言论演变的方法。 我们还展示了对现有方法的修改,以便能够进行规模分析,我们提议并展示了一种无效的模型比较测试,以过滤虚假的动态。 关键的调查结果表明,政治和社会争议性议题在嵌入空间方面呈现出显著的方向飘移,各专题之间的距离随着时间推移而发生系统性变化,超出了无效模式所能解释的范围,而音乐和体育等领域则保持相对稳定。

articles.title: Open-MOPD: Diagnosing and Fixing Capability Imbalance in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
articles.content: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (M-OPD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for consolidating domain-specialized reinforcement learning (RL) experts into a single generalist student via dense, token-level reward supervision. Despite its practical success, the optimization dynamics governing multi-teacher capability integration remain poorly understood, and open, rigorously reproducible recipes are conspicuously lacking. In this work, we establish a controlled M-OPD benchmark on SmolLM3-3B-Base with oracle routing, isolating capability integration from routing ambiguity. Our investigation reveals a pronounced capability integration gap: standard M-OPD captures only 35.6% of the available headroom relative to a domain-routed oracle ensemble, with concise tasks such as instruction following suffering severe degradation and premature stagnation. Crucially, we show that this failure stems not from gradient conflict, but from a severe misallocation of the token-level optimization budget. This pathology is driven by three orthogonal factors: structural sequence-length disparities across domains, dynamic convergence drift due to non-uniform learning rates, and multi-step reward staleness from asynchronous policy updates. To resolve these imbalances, we introduce Open-MOPD, a principled framework incorporating token-share balancing, gap-aware dynamic budget allocation, and student reward refresh. Together, these mechanisms systematically restore cross-domain balance, elevating headroom recovery from 35.6% to 83.4% in a single deployable student. We fully open-source our end-to-end post-training recipe, training trajectories, and evaluation suites on an academically accessible hardware budget.

articles.title: When Readability and Source Retention Diverge: An Evaluability Gap in AI Translation
articles.content: Readable AI output can leave an evaluability gap: even when the source is shown, an overall-quality judgment may not reflect what an output preserves. We investigated how source-text condition and output rendering relate to perceived translation quality, and how output and system appraisals relate to trust and stated disclosure willingness in a plain-text interface. A focal 2 * 2 comparison (N=306) using TransLingo examined simple generated narratives and complex literary-philosophical prose alongside LLM-generated readability-oriented outputs and researcher-revised fidelity-oriented outputs. A descriptive stimulus audit indicated greater source retention in fidelity-oriented outputs in both source-text conditions. Factorial analyses showed a significant rendering-by-source-text-condition interaction in perceived quality. Participants rated fidelity-oriented outputs higher than readability-oriented outputs for the simple narratives, whereas no reliable rendering difference emerged for the complex prose. A corresponding source-condition-dependent pattern was observed for perceived intelligence, agency-oriented anthropomorphic attribution, and task-performance trust. A separate theory-ordered appraisal-structure SEM characterized concurrent associations among perceived quality, perceived intelligence, agency-oriented anthropomorphic attribution, task-performance trust, and stated disclosure willingness across six domains, with task-performance trust as the proximal correlate of stated willingness. The observed rating pattern distinguishes source access from source evaluability: for the complex stimuli, displaying the source did not ensure that one overall-quality rating reflected differences in retained content. It also separates support for evaluating translation output from data-handling support for decisions about what personal text to entrust to a system.

articles.title: ReWEIGH the Evidence: Calibrating Token-Level Ordinal Visual Evidence to Mitigate Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) often hallucinate, generating content that the input image does not support. Preventing such content during decoding calls for a candidate-specific measure of how strongly the image supports the token under consideration. The model's visual-token states offer a natural source of this evidence because projecting each state through the output head reveals which vocabulary items that position favors. These position-wise readouts cannot be pooled directly because their probability magnitudes are not comparable across visual positions. Vocabulary ranks provide a scale-invariant basis for pooling, but tokens still differ systematically in their typical rank-based evidence. We propose ReWEIGH, a training-free decoding intervention that aggregates these ranks across visual positions and compares each candidate with a token-specific reference estimated from unlabeled images. At inference, ReWEIGH caches the image evidence during prefill and applies a bounded penalty only to candidates that fall below their reference. On four 7B backbones, ReWEIGH reduces hallucinated object mentions by up to 21.3% while largely preserving or improving descriptive and general performance. With evidence cached, the average added latency is 1.33% per token, and the reductions extend across six architecture families to 32B parameters.

articles.title_zh: ReWEIGH 证据:校正Token-Level 常规视觉证据,以缓解大视觉-语言模型中的幻觉
articles.content_zh: 大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)经常产生幻觉,生成输入图像不支持的内容. 在解码过程中防止这种内容,需要针对候选人具体衡量图像如何有力地支持正在审议的标志。 该模型的可视化键状态提供了这种证据的自然来源,因为通过输出头投射出每个状态会揭示哪些词汇项处于偏好位置. 这些位置读取无法直接集合,因为它们的概率大小在视觉位置之间并不具有可比性。 词汇分级为集合提供了规模变化不一的基础,但符号在典型的分级证据上仍然系统性地有差异. 我们提议ReWEIGH,一种无培训的解码干预,将这些排名汇总到不同视觉位置上,并将每个候选人与从未贴标签的图像中估计的具体符号参考进行比较。 推论,REWEGH在预填时会缓存图像证据,并且只对低于参考标准的候选人实施有限度的处罚. 在4个7B骨干上,REWEIGH将幻觉物体的提及减少21.3%,同时在很大程度上保留或改进描述性和一般性能. 证据被缓存后,平均增加的耐久性为每令牌1.33%,削减范围由6个建筑家族扩大到32B参数.

articles.title: What is Missing from AI Post-Training AI: An Empirical Analysis
articles.content: Large language model (LLM) agents can now post-train an LLM end-to-end. They can write code, launch training, evaluate checkpoints, and improve downstream performance, raising the prospect of AI-for-AI. We argue that this picture conflates two distinct capabilities: execution-level capability, iterating within a selected training strategy; and strategy-level capability, revising the high-level judgment as experimental evidence accumulates. Analyzing a large corpus of publicly released post-training trajectories, we find that across different tasks, the agent's training strategy is locked in at the very beginning, and the entire remaining budget is spent on local adjustments within the selected strategy. We then examine three natural explanations--missing experience, missing guidance, and insufficient reasoning--with escalating interventions. Extensive experiments show that (1) an experience-driven scaffold improves execution across the board (+12.6 points on GSM8K and +40.8 on HumanEval) but leaves the strategy static; (2) human guidance effectively redirects the initial strategy, yet the agent falls back into local adjustment loops once training starts; and (3) additional inference compute pays off on easier tasks but yields almost no gain on the hardest one. In conclusion, what agents lack is neither experience, guidance, nor reasoning compute, but a mechanism for spontaneously reevaluating their strategy during execution.

articles.title: Adaptive Memory and Reflection Multi-Agent System for Medical Question Answering
articles.content: Accurate and responsible medical question answering (QA) is important in healthcare, where complex cases require factual knowledge and nuanced reasoning. Existing medical QA systems, typically based on single-agent architectures and static retrieval, often lack adaptability, persistent memory, and structured decision-making. This work introduces an adaptive memory and reflection (AMR) agentic system, a multi-agent framework in which specialized agents use dedicated memory and reflection-based feedback to retrieve relevant prior cases and improve subsequent reasoning. Complexity assessment routes questions through solo, collaborative, or escalated workflows, while consensus and ethical overseer modules support reasoning consolidation and output review. Evaluation on MedQA and MedMCQA demonstrates strong performance compared with several baselines. Ablation studies show that combining agent-specific memory, reflection, and external retrieval yields the strongest performance. These findings highlight the potential of structured memory and feedback for developing more trustworthy medical agents. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/mm-air/AMR-Agent.

articles.title: Institutional Books - Enriched Text: A customizable multilingual open-source pipeline for denoising, deduplicating, and annotating OCR text at scale
articles.content:
Released in 2025, Institutional Books: Harvard Library (IB-HL) is a collection of 983,004 volumes (242B o200k_base tokens), originally digitized through Harvard Library's participation in the Google Books Library project. As researchers and developers have begun to use IB-HL, a tension has emerged between standard large-scale preprocessing practices and the goals of careful information stewardship. Many existing pipelines optimize for web text: as a result, they tend to aggressively filter, deduplicate, restrict by language, and sometimes discard meaningful metadata. Meanwhile, researchers seeking to use IB-HL duplicate effort while performing similar processing and analysis.
  We describe an approach that we call Enriched Text. Instead of producing a single 'complete' stream of tokens, we normalize the text while preserving metadata through annotations. We separate endmatter, detect per-paragraph language, identify clusters of duplicate paragraphs, and compute per-paragraph bits-per-byte scores. We provide this information through HTML-like annotations layered on top of the text. By parsing these annotations, users can tailor the output to their own needs instead of accepting a global editorial decision on content. The pipeline applies to all $\approx$250 languages in the collection.
  This report describes this project's goals, implementation, and design rationale. The release includes IB-HL-ET (an enriched-text version of IB-HL containing 217B o200k_base tokens across 983,003 volumes, organized into 1.39B annotated subtopic paragraphs) and the pipeline that produced it. These serve to make the collection easier for machines to parse and for humans to study.

articles.title: Grading the Graders: Verification Autonomy Levels (L0-L5) for LLM Reasoning
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly paired with verifiers (step checkers, self-consistency filters, tool-based fact checkers, formal proof assistants) that claim to detect the model's errors. Yet the verification literature uses the word "level" to mean at least five different things: verification granularity, concept abstraction, risk tier, system-stack layer, and the epistemic source of the ground truth. We propose Verification Autonomy Levels (VAL), a meta-standard classifying verification schemes along a single axis: where does the verification spec come from, and what does the verdict guarantee? VAL ranges from L0 (LLM self-declaration, no deterministic anchor) through L2 (objective ground truth, correctness only) to L3/L4 (decidable systems with single-property or domain-level completeness), with L5 impossible in the unrestricted case. Central to VAL is the completeness blind spot: substitution- and sampling-based verifiers can confirm that proposed candidates hold, but cannot prove that no candidate was missed. We further identify a dichotomy the literature has not stated: completeness is reachable only for formally specifiable properties, while empirical open-world verification (fact-checking, diagnosis) caps at anchored correctness (L2). We document this across four domains (symbolic mathematics, behavior monitoring, medical diagnosis, and code generation) and in the strongest existing formal-verification baseline, whose authors note the verifier "focuses on the correctness of each step." We show the levels of granularity, concept hierarchy, risk, and system stack are orthogonal to VAL, resolving a systematic conflation across 17 surveyed papers. Code and full assessment are released as supplementary material.
